title_quote: Hi, I'm Peter, the new roommate.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🛏️ 實用室友初見必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡800句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 800 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Meeting Your New Roommate
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用的室友初見情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從第一天抱著箱子進三B房、互報名字與科系、談好幾點關燈與安靜時間、分冰箱層架並貼名字標籤、切一張清潔輪值表、約洗衣機幾點可以開、晚上一起煮一碗麵、規定帶朋友來的上限與毛巾歸屬，一直到在冰箱門上留字條、把備用鑰匙放進藍色小盒子。兩個人把數字講得清清楚楚：房租一個月一千二、一人六百、押金同樣一千二、水電大約八十所以一人四十（這個月結算是四十一），安靜時間從晚上十點半到早上七點，星期三倒垃圾、星期六十點以後才用吸塵器，星期五晚上在房間煮湯。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Meeting Your New Roommate phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue) — two students meet on moving day in room 3B, trade names and majors, agree when the lights go off and which hours are quiet, split the fridge shelves and tape names on the yogurt, cut a cleaning chart in half, negotiate washer hours, boil one bowl of noodles together at night, set the rules for bringing friends over, and end the month with fridge notes and a spare key in a blue box. Rent is twelve hundred a month, six hundred each, deposit twelve hundred, utilities about eighty so forty each. Quiet hours run from ten thirty at night to seven in the morning, trash goes out on Wednesday, and the vacuum waits until Saturday after ten. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm Peter, the new roommate.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪm ˈpitɚ, ðə nu ˈrumˌeɪt./
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我是彼得，新來的室友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm Nora, and I moved in this morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ˈnɔrə, ænd aɪ mud ɪn ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我是諾拉，今天早上搬來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Room three B is ours, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /rum θri bi ɪz ɑz, ˈraɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 三B房間是我們兩個人的，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the sticker says three B.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə ˈstɪkɚ sɛz θri bi./
dialogue.zh: 對，門上的貼紙寫三B。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These two boxes already weigh a ton.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz tu ˈbɑksɪz ɔlˈrɛdi we ə tʌn./
dialogue.zh: 這兩個箱子重得要命。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Want the smaller one? It holds books.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑnt ðə ˈsmɔlər wʌn? ɪt hoʊldz bʊks./
dialogue.zh: 要那個小一點的嗎？裡面是書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, books hurt my back.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, bʊks hɝt maɪ bæk./
dialogue.zh: 不用，書會傷到我的背。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then take the soft one with blankets.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn teɪk ðə sɔft wʌn wɪð ˈblæŋkɪts./
dialogue.zh: 那你抱那袋毛毯，軟的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The key won't turn at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ki woʊnt tɝn æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 鑰匙完全轉不動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift the door and try again.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪft ðə dɔr ænd traɪ əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 把門往上抬一點再試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, it opened with one push.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr, ɪt ˈoʊpənd wɪð wʌn pʊʃ./
dialogue.zh: 開了，輕輕一推就開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The old doors stick in this building.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði oʊld dɔrz stɪk ɪn ðɪs ˈbɪldɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 這棟樓的舊門都卡卡的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No elevator, only these long stairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈɛləˌveɪtɚ, ˈoʊnli ðiz lɔŋ stɛrz./
dialogue.zh: 沒有電梯，只有這長長的樓梯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Third floor, I carried mine by hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɝd flɔr, aɪ ˈkærid maɪn baɪ hænd./
dialogue.zh: 三樓，我自己的都是一人搬上來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's rest a second in the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts rɛst ə ˈsɛkənd ɪn ðə hɔl./
dialogue.zh: 先在走道上歇一下吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My arms are shaking, but I'm fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ɑrmz ɑr ˈʃeɪkɪŋ, bət aɪm faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 我手臂在抖，不過還好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone wrote kitchen on this box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌwʌn roʊt ˈkɪtʃɪn ɑn ðɪs bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 有人在這個箱子上寫了廚房。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one is mine, with pots and pans.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn ɪz maɪn, wɪð pɑts ænd pænz./
dialogue.zh: 那是我的，裝鍋子跟平底鍋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My plates are in the other box.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈpleɪts ɑr ɪn ði ˈʌðɚ bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 我的盤子在另一個箱子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can put both near the stove.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn pʊt boʊθ nɪr ðə stoʊv./
dialogue.zh: 我們把兩樣都放到爐子旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your box says fragile in red.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr bɑks sɛz ˈfrædʒəl ɪn rɛd./
dialogue.zh: 你的箱子上用紅筆寫著易碎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please hold it by the bottom.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz hoʊld ɪt baɪ ðə ˈbɑtəm./
dialogue.zh: 請從下面托著它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's only one bowl and two mugs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈoʊnli wʌn boʊl ænd tu mʌɡz./
dialogue.zh: 裡面只有一個碗跟兩個杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My mother gave me that bowl.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈmʌðɚ ɡeɪv mi ðæt boʊl./
dialogue.zh: 那個碗是我媽媽給我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, this one stays safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, ðɪs wʌn steɪz seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 好，這個我會放穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, I trust it with you now.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks, aɪ trʌst ɪt wɪð ju naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，那它就交給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The desk has a big scratch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɛsk hæz ə bɪɡ skrætʃ./
dialogue.zh: 書桌上有一道很大的刮痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use your poster to cover it up.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz jɔr ˈpoʊstɚ tə ˈkʌvɚ ɪt ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 用你的海報把它蓋住就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smart idea, I have two posters.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt aɪˈdiə, aɪ hæv tu ˈpoʊstɚz./
dialogue.zh: 聰明，我有兩張海報。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This chair wobbles on one leg.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs tʃɛr ˈwɑbəlz ɑn wʌn lɛɡ./
dialogue.zh: 這張椅子有一隻腳會晃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fold some paper and put it under.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊld sʌm ˈpeɪpɚ ænd pʊt ɪt ˈʌndɚ./
dialogue.zh: 摺張紙墊在椅腳下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now it sits still, good as new.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪt sɪts stɪl, ɡʊd æz nu./
dialogue.zh: 現在穩了，跟新的一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which side of the bed is mine?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ saɪd ʌv ðə bɛd ɪz maɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 床的哪一邊是我的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the window side, you look cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə ˈwɪndoʊ saɪd, ju lʊk koʊld./
dialogue.zh: 你睡窗邊吧，你看起來很怕冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How did you know I sleep cold?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ dɪd ju noʊ aɪ slip koʊld?/
dialogue.zh: 你怎麼知道我睡覺怕冷？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You keep your jacket on inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kip jɔr ˈdʒækɪt ɑn ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 你在室內都還穿著外套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The window won't close all the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɪndoʊ woʊnt kloʊz ɔl ðə weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 窗戶關不緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push the corner hard, then lock it.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ ðə ˈkɔrnɚ hɑrd, ðɛn lɑk ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 用力推那個角，再上鎖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rain is coming, I heard it on TV.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪn ɪz ˈkʌmɪŋ, aɪ hɝd ɪt ɑn ˌtiˈvi./
dialogue.zh: 要下雨了，我在電視上看到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then bring your wet shoes inside soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn brɪŋ jɔr wɛt ʃuz ɪnˈsaɪd sun./
dialogue.zh: 那等一下把濕鞋子帶進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The closet still has old hangers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈklɑzət stɪl hæz oʊld ˈhæŋɚz./
dialogue.zh: 衣櫃裡還有舊衣架。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The last roommate left everything behind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læst ˈrumˌeɪt lɛft ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ bɪˈhaɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 上一個室友什麼都沒帶走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some shirts still hang on the rod.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm ʃɝtz stɪl hæŋ ɑn ðə rɑd./
dialogue.zh: 幾件襯衫還掛在桿子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe he will email us about them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi hi wɪl ˈiˌmeɪl ʌs əˈbaʊt ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 也許他會寄信來問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need tools for my bed frame.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid tulz fɔr maɪ bɛd freɪm./
dialogue.zh: 我組床需要工具。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a toolbox under the sink.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə ˈtulˌbɑks ˈʌndɚ ðə sɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 水槽下面有一個工具箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One screw is missing from part four.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn skru ɪz ˈmɪsɪŋ frʌm pɑrt fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 第四個零件少了一顆螺絲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the small bag with spare nails.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðə smɔl bæɡ wɪð spɛr neɪlz./
dialogue.zh: 試試那袋備用釘子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This long one fits almost perfectly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs lɔŋ wʌn fɪts ˈɔlmoʊst ˈpɝfɪktli./
dialogue.zh: 這根長的剛好可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your bed looks solid now, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr bɛd lʊks ˈsɑlɪd naʊ, tu./
dialogue.zh: 你的床現在搖起來也很穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's cut this tape with the knife.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts kʌt ðɪs teɪp wɪð ðə naɪf./
dialogue.zh: 用刀子把膠帶割開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, pull the box toward you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrfəl, pʊl ðə bɑks təˈwɔrd ju./
dialogue.zh: 小心，把箱子往自己這邊拉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I almost cut my thumb there.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɔlmoʊst kʌt maɪ θʌm ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 我剛剛差點割到拇指。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit down, I will open the rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt daʊn, aɪ wɪl ˈoʊpən ðə rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 你坐著，剩下的我來開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are the boss of boxes today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr ðə bɔs ʌv ˈbɑksɪz təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 今天開箱子由你說了算。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only because my knife is sharper.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli bɪˈkɔz maɪ naɪf ɪz ˈʃɑrpɚ./
dialogue.zh: 因為我的刀子比較利。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want water from the tap?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju wɑnt ˈwɔtɚ frʌm ðə tæp?/
dialogue.zh: 你要喝自來水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Boil it first, the taste is odd.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɔɪ ɪt fɝst, ðə teɪst ɪz ɑd./
dialogue.zh: 先煮沸，味道怪怪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have two bottles in my bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv tu ˈbɑtəlz ɪn maɪ bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 我袋子裡還有兩瓶水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, we can share one now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt, wi kæn ʃɛr wʌn naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我們現在分一瓶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five boxes down, six still in the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈbɑksɪz daʊn, sɪks stɪl ɪn ðə hɔl./
dialogue.zh: 搬進來五個，還有六個在走道上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave them tonight and sleep on the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ðɛm təˈnaɪt ænd slip ɑn ðə bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 今晚先放著，先上床睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You really should not decide for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈrɪli ʃʊd nɑt dɪˈsaɪd fɔr mi./
dialogue.zh: 你真的不能替我做決定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, I only meant you look tired.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri, aɪ ˈoʊnli mɛnt ju lʊk ˈtaɪərd./
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我只是看起來你累了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are right, I am tired.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr raɪt, aɪ æm ˈtaɪərd./
dialogue.zh: 你說得對，我累了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tonight we only set up the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈnaɪt wi ˈoʊnli sɛt ʌp ðə bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 今晚我們只把床鋪好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need clean sheets and one pillow.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid klin ʃits ænd wʌn ˈpɪloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我需要乾淨的床單跟一個枕頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine are still folded in a bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn ɑr stɪl ˈfoʊldɪd ɪn ə bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 我的還摺好在袋子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take the spare pillow from my shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə spɛr ˈpɪloʊ frʌm maɪ ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 從我架子上拿那個備用枕頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Are you sure? You sleep with two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ju ʃʊr? ju slip wɪð tu./
dialogue.zh: 你確定嗎？你睡覺要用兩個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can sleep with one for now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn slip wɪð wʌn fɔr naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我現在用一個就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then thank you, Peter, that is kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn θæŋk ju, ˈpitɚ, ðæt ɪz kaɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 那就謝謝你，彼得，你真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your fan is loud but steady.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr fæn ɪz laʊd bət ˈstɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 你的電扇很大聲但很穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I like it; it hides street noise.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk ɪt; ɪt haɪdz strit nɔɪz./
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡，它可以蓋掉街上的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone needs the only good plug.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn nidz ði ˈoʊnli ɡʊd plʌɡ./
dialogue.zh: 我的手機需要那個最好的插座。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use mine tonight, I charge at desk level.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz maɪn təˈnaɪt, aɪ tʃɑrdʒ æt dɛsk ˈlɛvəl./
dialogue.zh: 今晚用我那個，我趴著充就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That plug sits right beside my bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt plʌɡ sɪts raɪt bɪˈsaɪd maɪ bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 那個插座就在床旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? We already share well.
dialogue.phonetic: /si? wi ɔlˈrɛdi ʃɛr wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 看到了吧？我們已經很會分工。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The floor is dirty from the move.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə flɔr ɪz ˈdɝti frʌm ðə muv./
dialogue.zh: 搬完地板全髒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a broom behind the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə brum bɪˈhaɪnd ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 門後面有一把掃把。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will sweep, you hold the pan.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl swip, ju hoʊld ðə pæn./
dialogue.zh: 我掃，你拿畚箕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done. Look, no dust left at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn. lʊk, noʊ dʌst lɛft æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 好了，一點灰塵都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We make a fast team, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi meɪk ə fæst tim, ju noʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我們兩個配合得挺快的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A good start for one year.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɡʊd stɑrt fɔr wʌn jɪr./
dialogue.zh: 這一年的好開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The last light in the hall is out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læst laɪt ɪn ðə hɔl ɪz aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 走道最後一盞燈熄了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we should stop and talk quietly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi ʃʊd stɑp ænd tɔk ˈkwaɪətli./
dialogue.zh: 那我們該停下來小聲說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I do not even know your major.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du nɑt ˈiːvən noʊ jɔr ˈmeɪdʒɚ./
dialogue.zh: 我連你讀什麼都不知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit on your bed, I will tell all.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt ɑn jɔr bɛd, aɪ wɪl tɛl ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 坐到你床上，我全部告訴你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, your name is short for something.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɝst, jɔr neɪm ɪz ʃɔrt fɔr ˈsʌmˌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 先說，妳的名字是暱稱吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Norine, but nobody can say that.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɔˈrin, bət ˈnoʊbəˌdi kæn seɪ ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 全名是諾琳，但沒人念得出。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will keep Nora, it fits you.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kip ˈnɔrə, ɪt fɪts ju./
dialogue.zh: 我還是叫你諾拉，很適合。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will call you Peter, not Pete.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kɔl ju ˈpitɚ, nɑt pit./
dialogue.zh: 我會叫你彼得，不會叫皮特。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pete sounds like a small kid.
dialogue.phonetic: /pit saʊndz laɪk ə smɔl kɪd./
dialogue.zh: 皮特聽起來像小孩子的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Peter it is, loud and clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpitɚ ɪt ɪz, laʊd ænd klɪr./
dialogue.zh: 那就叫彼得，清楚明白。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The boxes can wait till next weekend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbɑksɪz kæn weɪt tɪl nɛkst ˈwikˌɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 箱子可以留到下個週末再弄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, the room feels like home already.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡrid, ðə rum filz laɪk hoʊm ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 同意，這房間已經像家了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, roommate, in a real bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt, ˈrumˌeɪt, ɪn ə ril bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 晚安了，室友，終於睡到真的床。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep well, and keep one light off.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip wɛl, ænd kip wʌn laɪt ɔf./
dialogue.zh: 好好睡，記得關一盞燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, one small favor first, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, wʌn smɔl ˈfɛvɚ fɝst, pliz./
dialogue.zh: 等等，先答應我一件小事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell me now, my eyes are closing.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi naʊ, maɪ aɪz ɑr ˈkloʊzɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 現在說，我眼睛都快閉起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I still need your full name, Nora.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ stɪl nid jɔr fʊl neɪm, ˈnɔrə./
dialogue.zh: 我還需要妳的大名，諾拉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nora Lin, and you are Peter Ho.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɔrə lɪn, ænd ju ɑr ˈpitɚ hoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 諾拉．林，你是彼得．何。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My family name comes first at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈfæməli neɪm kʌmz fɝst æt hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 在我家，我的姓都寫在前面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here the school form wants it last.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ðə skul fɔrm wɑnts ɪt læst./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡學校表格要把姓放後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am older by four months only.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈoʊldɚ baɪ fɔr mʌnθs ˈoʊnli./
dialogue.zh: 我只大妳四個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the bigger shelf is yours, of course.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə ˈbɪɡɚ ʃɛlf ɪz jɔrz, ʌv kɔrs./
dialogue.zh: 那較大的架子當然歸你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You carried more boxes, so you keep it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈkærid mɔr ˈbɑksɪz, soʊ ju kip ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 妳搬比較多箱子，所以留給妳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where is your hometown, then, Peter?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz jɔr ˈhaʊmˌtaʊn, ðɛn, ˈpitɚ?/
dialogue.zh: 那你家鄉在哪裡，彼得？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hometown sits next to the sea.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈhaʊmˌtaʊn sɪts nɛkst tu ðə si./
dialogue.zh: 我家鄉就在海邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine is deep inside the mountains.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn ɪz dip ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈmaʊntənz./
dialogue.zh: 我的故鄉在山裡很深的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do your parents know this address?
dialogue.phonetic: /du jɔr ˈpɛrənts noʊ ðɪs əˈdrɛs?/
dialogue.zh: 你爸媽知道這個地址嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My mother has it saved in her phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈmʌðɚ hæz ɪt seɪvd ɪn hɝ foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 我媽媽把它存在手機裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine will ask for photos first.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn wɪl æsk fɔr ˈfoʊtoʊz fɝst./
dialogue.zh: 我爸媽一定會先要照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send them one of this messy room.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnd ðɛm wʌn ʌv ðɪs ˈmɛsi rum./
dialogue.zh: 就傳一張這個亂房間給他們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Later, after the floor is clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈleɪtɚ, ˈæftɚ ðə flɔr ɪz klin./
dialogue.zh: 等地板掃乾淨再傳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, and after we sweep tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡrid, ænd ˈæftɚ wi swip təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 同意，而且等我們今晚掃完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Second year, or third year for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛkənd jɪr, ɔr θɝd jɪr fɔr ju?/
dialogue.zh: 你是二年級還是三年級？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Third, and you are still second.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɝd, ænd ju ɑr stɪl ˈsɛkənd./
dialogue.zh: 三年級，你還讀二年級。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A long road, nursing, is it not?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə lɔŋ roʊd, ˈnɝsɪŋ, ɪz ɪt nɑt?/
dialogue.zh: 護理這條路很長，不是嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It adds one whole extra year.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ædz wʌn hoʊl ˈɛkstrə jɪr./
dialogue.zh: 它會多整整一年。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine classes this term, all morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˈklæsɪz ðɪs tɝm, ɔl ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 這學期我九堂課，全在上午。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight for me, plus one long lab.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt fɔr mi, plʌs wʌn lɔŋ læb./
dialogue.zh: 我八堂，外加一堂很長的實驗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which days do you walk to campus?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ deɪz du ju wɔk tu ˈkæmpəs?/
dialogue.zh: 你星期哪幾天走路去學校？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Monday through Friday, rain or shine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌnˌdeɪ θru ˈfraɪˌdeɪ, reɪn ɔr ʃaɪn./
dialogue.zh: 星期一到星期五，不管下雨或晴天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wednesday is empty on my schedule.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛnzˌdeɪ ɪz ˈɛmpˌti ɑn maɪ ˈskɛdʒul./
dialogue.zh: 星期三我完全沒有安排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Remember, Wednesday is our trash night.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈmɛmbɚ, ˈwɛnzˌdeɪ ɪz ɑʊr træʃ naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 記得喔，星期三是我們倒垃圾的晚上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anatomy must be your hardest course.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌænəˈtɑmi mʌst bi jɔr ˈhɑrdɪst kɔrs./
dialogue.zh: 解剖學一定是妳最難的課。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, every name is in old Latin.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈɛvri neɪm ɪz ɪn oʊld ˈlætən./
dialogue.zh: 對，每個名字都是古拉丁文。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My statistics teacher talks too fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ stəˈtɪstɪks ˈtitʃɚ tɔks tu fæst./
dialogue.zh: 我統計課老師講得太快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Record the lecture with your phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈkɔrd ðə ˈlɛktʃɚ wɪð jɔr foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 用你的手機把課錄下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He says that is against the rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɛz ðæt ɪz əˈɡɛnst ðə rul./
dialogue.zh: 他說那樣違反規定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then write three words per slide only.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn raɪt θri wɜrdz pɝ slaɪd ˈoʊnli./
dialogue.zh: 那每張投影片只寫三個字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good trick, my notebook stays small.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd trɪk, maɪ ˈnotˌbʊk steɪz smɔl./
dialogue.zh: 好方法，我的筆記本就變薄了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now use it in all nine classes.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ juz ɪt ɪn ɔl naɪn ˈklæsɪz./
dialogue.zh: 現在你九堂課都這樣用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do you sit in the library?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du ju sɪt ɪn ðə ˈlaɪˌbɛrɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 你在圖書館都坐在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Second floor, the table by the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛkənd flɔr, ðə ˈteɪbəl baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 二樓，靠窗那一桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My usual seat is number nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈjuʒəəl sit ɪz ˈnʌmbɚ naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 我慣常的座位是九號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then ten is free for me tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tɛn ɪz fri fɔr mi təˈmɑroʊ./
dialogue.zh: 那明天十號就換我坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I work Saturdays at the print shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɜrk ˈsætəˌdeɪz æt ðə prɪnt ʃɑp./
dialogue.zh: 我星期六在印刷店打工。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four hours each time, and free paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈaʊɚz itʃ taɪm, ænd fri ˈpeɪpɚ./
dialogue.zh: 一次四小時，還有免費的紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My uncle taught me to fix the machine.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈʌŋkəl tɔt mi tə fɪks ðə məˈʃin./
dialogue.zh: 我叔叔教我怎麼修那台機器。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, my notebook is almost full already.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs, maɪ ˈnotˌbʊk ɪz ˈɔlmoʊst fʊl ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 真好，我的筆記本快寫完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you still want to be a nurse?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju stɪl wɑnt tu bi ə nɝs?/
dialogue.zh: 你還是想當護士嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Since I was small, so the answer is yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪns aɪ wʌz smɔl, soʊ ði ˈænsɚ ɪz jɛs./
dialogue.zh: 從我很小就想，所以答案是肯定的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your hands shake when you see blood?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr hændz ʃeɪk wɛn ju si blʌd?/
dialogue.zh: 妳看到血手會抖嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the first time; now they stay still.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðə fɝst taɪm; naʊ ðeɪ steɪ stɪl./
dialogue.zh: 只有第一次，現在都很穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why this old apartment, out of all places?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ðɪs oʊld əˈpɑrtmənt, ɑʊt ʌv ɔl ˈplæsɪz?/
dialogue.zh: 這麼多地方，為什麼選這間舊公寓？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bus to campus takes twelve minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bʌs tu ˈkæmpəs teɪks twɛlv ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 到學校的公車只要十二分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also the street feels quiet at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ ðə strit filz ˈkwaɪət æt naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 而且這條街晚上感覺很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the price beat every other room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə praɪs bit ˈɛvri ˈʌðɚ rum./
dialogue.zh: 價格也比所有別的房間便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our rent is twelve hundred monthly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊr rɛnt ɪz twɛlv ˈhʌndɚd ˈmʌnθli./
dialogue.zh: 我們的房租一個月一千二。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So each of us owes six hundred.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ itʃ ʌv ʌs oʊz sɪks ˈhʌndɚd./
dialogue.zh: 所以我們一人要付六百。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pay by the first, never on the fifth.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪ baɪ ðə fɝst, ˈnɛvɚ ɑn ðə faɪfθ./
dialogue.zh: 一號之前就繳，別拖到五號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The landlord adds a late fee then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlændˌlɔrd ædz ə leɪt fi ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那時候房東會加逾期費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much was the deposit, exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ wʌz ðə dɪˈpɑzɪt, ɪɡˈzæktli?/
dialogue.zh: 押金準確來說是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve hundred, one month, held at the bank.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ˈhʌndɚd, wʌn mʌnθ, hɛld æt ðə bæŋk./
dialogue.zh: 一千二，一個月的，放在銀行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We get it back if the walls stay clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɡɛt ɪt bæk ɪf ðə wɔlz steɪ klin./
dialogue.zh: 只要牆面保持乾淨就能拿回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We must not put tape on the paint.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi mʌst nɑt pʊt teɪp ɑn ðə peɪnt./
dialogue.zh: 我們不可以把膠帶黏在油漆上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Utilities run about eighty dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /juˈtɪlətiz rʌn əˈbaʊt ˈeɪti ˈdɑlɚz./
dialogue.zh: 水電費大約八十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So forty each, that math is easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈfɔrti itʃ, ðæt mæθ ɪz ˈizi./
dialogue.zh: 所以一人四十，這算法很簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The internet bill is inside our rent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɪntɚˌnɛt bɪl ɪz ɪnˈsaɪd ɑʊr rɛnt./
dialogue.zh: 網路費包含在我們的房租裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, my plan at home cost much more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, maɪ plæn æt hoʊm kɔst mʌtʃ mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 好，我在家用的方案貴得多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why not live in the dorm, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ nɑt lɪv ɪn ðə dɔrm, ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 那為什麼不住宿舍？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Curfew at midnight and the same food daily.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɜrfju æt ˈmɪdˌnaɪt ænd ðə seɪm fud ˈdeɪli./
dialogue.zh: 半夜十二點門禁，每天還吃一樣的飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The dining hall menu repeats every week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdaɪnɪŋ hɔl ˈmɛnu rɪˈpits ˈɛvri wik./
dialogue.zh: 學校餐廳的菜單每週重複。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here I can cook my own noodles.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr aɪ kæn kʊk maɪ oʊn ˈnudəlz./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡我可以煮自己的麵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your English sounds fine to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ saʊndz faɪn tu mi./
dialogue.zh: 我覺得你的英文聽起來很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At night my words get slow, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt naɪt maɪ wɜrdz ɡɛt sloʊ, ðoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 只是到了晚上我的話會變慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stop me and ask again, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑp mi ænd æsk əˈɡɛn, ˈɔlweɪz./
dialogue.zh: 隨時打斷我再問一次，都可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same rule from me, no shyness here.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm rul frʌm mi, noʊ ˈʃaɪnɪs hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我也同一條規矩，在這裡不用害羞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We speak English in this room, deal?
dialogue.phonetic: /wi spit ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ɪn ðɪs rum, dil?/
dialogue.zh: 我們在這個房間講英文，好不好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, even when I am half asleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil, ˈivən wɛn aɪ æm hæf əˈslip./
dialogue.zh: 好，就算我半睡半醒也講。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My grandmother worries when I travel.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈɡrænmʌðɚ ˈwɝiz wɛn aɪ ˈtrævəl./
dialogue.zh: 我阿嬤我一出門就擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write her one line each Sunday morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt hɝ wʌn laɪn itʃ ˈsʌnˌdeɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 每個星期日上午給她寫一句。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She will keep that paper note forever.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi wɪl kip ðæt ˈpeɪpɚ noʊt fɚˈrɛvɚ./
dialogue.zh: 她會把那張紙條永遠留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine keeps all of them in a shoe box.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn kips ɔl ʌv ðɛm ɪn ə ʃu bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 我的祖母全都收在鞋盒裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A scholarship covers half my cost.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈskɑlɚˌʃɪp ˈkʌvɚz hæf maɪ kɔst./
dialogue.zh: 獎學金幫我付一半的費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lucky you; my parents loan me the rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʌki ju; maɪ ˈpɛrənts loʊn mi ðə rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 你真幸運；我爸媽借錢我付剩下的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Money is the hardest part of this year.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌni ɪz ðə ˈhɑrdɪst pɑrt ʌv ðɪs jɪr./
dialogue.zh: 錢是今年最難的一關。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we save every receipt this year.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi seɪv ˈɛvri rəˈsit ðɪs jɪr./
dialogue.zh: 那我們今年每張收據都收好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I study at this desk until one.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈstʌdi æt ðɪs dɛsk ʌnˈtɪl wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 我都這張書桌念到一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One is late for your morning class.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ɪz leɪt fɔr jɔr ˈmɔrnɪŋ klæs./
dialogue.zh: 對你的早課來說一點太晚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My lamp is small but saves my eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ læm ɪz smɔl bət seɪvz maɪ aɪz./
dialogue.zh: 我的燈很小，但保護眼睛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You need it badly, you stay up late.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju nid ɪt ˈbædli, ju steɪ ʌp leɪt./
dialogue.zh: 你真的很需要它，你都熬夜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My main light is bright, like a sun.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ meɪn laɪt ɪz braɪt, laɪk ə sʌn./
dialogue.zh: 我的主燈很亮，像一顆太陽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we must talk about lights tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi mʌst tɔk əˈbaʊt laɪts təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那我們今晚一定要談燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When do you turn your light off?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn du ju tɜrn jɔr laɪt ɔf?/
dialogue.zh: 妳幾點關燈？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eleven, or twelve when exams come.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈlɛvən, ɔr twɛlv wɛn ɪɡˈzæmz kʌm./
dialogue.zh: 十一點，考試週會到十二點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You were up at six, and it was bright.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wɜz ʌp æt sɪks, ænd ɪt wʌz braɪt./
dialogue.zh: 妳六點就起床，燈還很亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, my shift starts before eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri, maɪ ʃɪft stɑrts bɪˈfɔr eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我的班次八點前就要開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Monday shift again, every single week?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌnˌdeɪ ʃɪft əˈɡɛn, ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋɡəl wik?/
dialogue.zh: 每星期都是星期一臨床嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve hours there, then I crawl back.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ˈaʊɚz ðɛr, ðɛn aɪ krɔl bæk./
dialogue.zh: 在那裡十二個小時，然後我爬回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So you need quiet hours, like I do.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ju nid ˈkwaɪət aʊɚz, laɪk aɪ du./
dialogue.zh: 所以妳也需要安靜時段，跟我一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write our hours on that white card, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ɑʊr aʊɚz ɑn ðæt waɪt kɑrd, ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那就把我們的時段寫在那張白卡上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stick it beside the door, where both look.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪk ɪt bɪˈsaɪd ðə dɔr, wɛr boʊθ lʊk./
dialogue.zh: 貼在門邊，兩個人都會看的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, and I will fetch the marker.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡrid, ænd aɪ wɪl fɛtʃ ðə ˈmɑrkɚ./
dialogue.zh: 好，我去把麥克筆拿出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One thing is left: the light at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn θɪŋ ɪz lɛft: ðə laɪt æt naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 還剩一件事：晚上的燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and this time for real.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ænd ðɪs taɪm fɔr ril./
dialogue.zh: 對，這次真的要講了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lights first, then food and the chart.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪts fɝst, ðɛn fud ænd ðə tʃɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 先講燈，然後是吃的和輪值表。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, and no more boxes tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil, ænd noʊ mɔr ˈbɑksɪz təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 成交，今晚不再搬箱子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us set the light plan tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs sɛt ðə laɪt plæn təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我們今晚來定燈光計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with quiet hours, ten thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrt wɪð ˈkwaɪət aʊɚz, tɛn ˈθɝdi./
dialogue.zh: 先定安靜時段，十點半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten thirty at night until seven?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈθɝdi æt naɪt ʌnˈtɪl ˈsɛvən?/
dialogue.zh: 晚上十點半到早上七點？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, soft voices and no loud steps.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, sɔft ˈvɔɪsɪz ænd noʊ laʊd stɛps./
dialogue.zh: 對，小聲說話，腳步別重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that hurt your late studying?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðæt hɝt jɔr leɪt ˈstʌdɪɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 會不會影響你熬夜念書？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, my lamp is small after that hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, maɪ læm ɪz smɔl ˈæftɚ ðæt aʊɚ./
dialogue.zh: 不會，那個時段之後我用小燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then the main light dies at eleven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə meɪn laɪt daɪz æt ɪˈlɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 那主燈十一點就關掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, or I lose an hour of sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn tu, ɔr aɪ luz æn aʊɚ ʌv slip./
dialogue.zh: 我也是，不然我會少睡一小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An hour? You sleep only six?
dialogue.phonetic: /æn aʊɚ? ju slip ˈoʊnli sɪks?/
dialogue.zh: 一小時？妳只睡六小時？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six and a half when I can.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ænd ə hæf wɛn aɪ kæn./
dialogue.zh: 可以的話是六個半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is sad for a nurse student.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz sæd fɔr ə nɝs ˈstjudənt./
dialogue.zh: 對護理學生來說真可憐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sad, but the ward needs me early.
dialogue.phonetic: /sæd, bət ðə wɔrd nidz mi ˈɜrli./
dialogue.zh: 可憐，但病房需要我很早到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What sound does your alarm make?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt saʊnd dʌz jɔr əˈlɑrm meɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 你的鬧鐘是什麼聲音？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A loud beep, three times, then a song.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə laʊd bip, θri taɪmz, ðɛn ə sɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 很大聲的嗶三下，然後一首歌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do not use that near six.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du nɑt juz ðæt nɪr sɪks./
dialogue.zh: 拜託六點前後不要用那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then my watch will buzz on my wrist.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn maɪ wɑtʃ wɪl bʌz ɑn maɪ rɪst./
dialogue.zh: 那我的手錶會在手腕上震動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I sleep through thunder.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt, aɪ slip θru ˈθʌndɚ./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，打雷我都睡得著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And I sleep through your chair noise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd aɪ slip θru jɔr tʃɛr nɔɪz./
dialogue.zh: 我也能睡過你椅子的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My chair squeaks when I lean back.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ tʃɛr skwiks wɛn aɪ lin bæk./
dialogue.zh: 我一往後靠椅子就會叫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put a cloth under the back leg.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ə klɔθ ˈʌndɚ ðə bæk lɛɡ./
dialogue.zh: 在後椅腳墊一塊布。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You thought of everything, huh?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju θɔt ʌv ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ, hʌ?/
dialogue.zh: 什麼妳都想過了，嗯？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I had three roommates before you.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæd θri ˈrumˌmeɪts bɪˈfɔr ju./
dialogue.zh: 之前我當過三個人的室友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did all three end badly?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ɔl θri ɛnd ˈbædli?/
dialogue.zh: 那三個人最後都處得不好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One kept my food, one never slept.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn kept maɪ fud, wʌn ˈnɛvɚ slɛpt./
dialogue.zh: 一個吃我的東西，一個根本都不睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the one who kept food now?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ði wʌn hu kept fud naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 那個吃別人食物的現在在哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In another city, with a new note.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn əˈnʌðɚ ˈsɪti, wɪð ə nu noʊt./
dialogue.zh: 在別的城市，帶著新的紙條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So we start with labels today.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi stɑrt wɪð ˈleɪbəlz təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 所以我們今天先從標籤開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, the fridge story comes next.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli, ðə frɪdʒ ˈstɔri kʌmz nɛkst./
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，冰箱的事排在下一件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before that, the curtain problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔr ðæt, ðə ˈkɝtən ˈprɑbləm./
dialogue.zh: 在那之前，窗簾的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It hangs short, so light still leaks in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hæŋz ʃɔrt, soʊ laɪt stɪl liks ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 它太短了，光還會漏進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hall lamp, the old yellow one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hɔl læmp, ði oʊld ˈjɛloʊ wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 是走道那盞燈，舊舊的黃光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then hang your towel at the bottom.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn hæŋ jɔr ˈtaʊəl æt ðə ˈbɑtəm./
dialogue.zh: 那就在下面掛你的毛巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A towel works, I own two clean ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtaʊəl wɜrks, aɪ oʊn tu klin wʌnz./
dialogue.zh: 毛巾有效，我有兩條乾淨的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep one for the window, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip wʌn fɔr ðə ˈwɪndoʊ, tu./
dialogue.zh: 窗邊也留一條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The streetlight shines till three.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈstritˌlaɪt ʃaɪnz tɪl θri./
dialogue.zh: 路燈會亮到三點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then close the blind and wear socks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn kloʊz ðə blaɪnd ænd wɛr sɑks./
dialogue.zh: 那就拉上窗簾，再穿襪子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold feet keep me awake all night.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld fit kip mi əˈweɪk ɔl naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 腳冰冷會讓我一整晚睡不著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too; I sleep in fuzzy ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn tu; aɪ slip ɪn ˈfʌzi wʌnz./
dialogue.zh: 我也是，我穿著毛襪睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fuzzy, with the small bears on top?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfʌzi, wɪð ðə smɔl bɛrz ɑn tɑp?/
dialogue.zh: 毛襪，上面有小熊那種？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not read my drawer, Peter.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt rid maɪ drɔr, ˈpitɚ./
dialogue.zh: 別念我的抽屜清單，彼得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I saw them while I hunted tape.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɔ ðɛm waɪl aɪ ˈhʌntɪd teɪp./
dialogue.zh: 我找膠帶的時候看到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are warm and they are silent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɑr wɔrm ænd ðeɪ ɑr ˈsaɪlənt./
dialogue.zh: 它們很暖，而且完全無聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair point; I borrow one pair.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr pɔɪnt; aɪ ˈbɑroʊ wʌn pɛr./
dialogue.zh: 說得對，那我借一雙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Borrow two, yours have holes already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɑroʊ tu, jɔrz hæv hoʊlz ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 借兩雙吧，你的都有洞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those holes have a long story.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoʊz hoʊlz hæv ə lɔŋ ˈstɔri./
dialogue.zh: 那些洞有一個很長的故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell it sometime after eleven.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl ɪt ˈsʌmˌtaɪm ˈæftɚ ɪˈlɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 十一點以後再說給我聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fan: on, or off, at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fæn: ɑn, ɔr ɔf, æt naɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 電風扇晚上開還是關？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On, low, aimed at the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn, loʊ, eɪmd æt ðə wɔl./
dialogue.zh: 開小風，對著牆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Aim it at the wall and it hums.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪm ɪt æt ðə wɔl ænd ɪt hʌmz./
dialogue.zh: 對著牆吹它就會嗡嗡叫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then put a book under one foot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn pʊt ə bʊk ˈʌndɚ wʌn fʊt./
dialogue.zh: 那就在其中一腳下墊本書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your fixes are all cardboard.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈfɪksɪz ɑr ɔl ˈkɑrdˌbɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 你的修法全都靠紙板。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cardboard saves an old room cheaply.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑrdˌbɑrd seɪvz ən oʊld rum ˈtʃipli./
dialogue.zh: 紙板可以省錢救一間舊房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I hear you breathe from my bed?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ hɪr ju brið frʌm maɪ bɛd?/
dialogue.zh: 我在床上聽得到妳呼吸嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you press your ear flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf ju prɛs jɔr ɪr flæt./
dialogue.zh: 只有把耳朵壓平才聽得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, so we are both quiet people.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, soʊ wi ɑr boʊθ ˈkwaɪət ˈpipəl./
dialogue.zh: 好，那我們兩個都安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are loud when you eat chips.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr laʊd wɛn ju it tʃɪps./
dialogue.zh: 但你吃薯片的時候很吵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chips are loud everywhere, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɪps ɑr laʊd ˈɛvriˌwɛr, ˈsɑri./
dialogue.zh: 薯片在哪裡都很吵，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Crush them in the bag before bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /krʌʃ ðɛm ɪn ðə bæɡ bɪˈfɔr bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 睡前先在袋子裡壓碎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is cruel to the chips.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ˈkrul tu ðə tʃɪps./
dialogue.zh: 那樣對薯片太殘忍了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is kind to my sleep, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz kaɪnd tu maɪ slip, ðoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 但對我的睡眠很體貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I fall asleep in the chair?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf aɪ fɔl əˈslip ɪn ðə tʃɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我睡在椅子上怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will say your name twice, softly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl seɪ jɔr neɪm twaɪs, ˈsɔftli./
dialogue.zh: 我會小聲叫你的名字兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if saying it does nothing?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf ˈsɛɪɪŋ ɪt dʌz ˈnʌθɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 如果叫都沒有用呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I drape a blanket on you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ dreɪp ə ˈblæŋkɪt ɑn ju./
dialogue.zh: 那我就幫你蓋一條毯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: With the hood over my face?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð ðə hʊd ˈoʊvɚ maɪ feɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 帽兜還蓋住我的臉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That part is for my own fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt pɑrt ɪz fɔr maɪ oʊn fʌn./
dialogue.zh: 那部分是為了我自己好玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning rule: the kettle, not the blender.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔrnɪŋ rul: ðə ˈkɛtl, nɑt ðə ˈblɛndɚ./
dialogue.zh: 早上的規矩：用壺，不用果菜機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, the grinder sounds like a saw.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡrid, ðə ˈɡraɪndɚ saʊndz laɪk ə sɔ./
dialogue.zh: 同意，那研磨機聽起來像鋸子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No grinding before eight on weekdays.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈɡraɪndɪŋ bɪˈfɔr eɪt ɑn ˈwikˌdeɪz./
dialogue.zh: 平日八點以前不可以磨東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And none before nine on Sunday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd nʌn bɪˈfɔr naɪn ɑn ˈsʌnˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 星期天九點以前也不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I wake late only on Sunday.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ weɪk leɪt ˈoʊnli ɑn ˈsʌnˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我只有星期天會晚起。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same here, so Sunday is our quiet day.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm hɪr, soʊ ˈsʌnˌdeɪ ɪz ɑʊr ˈkwaɪət deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我也是，所以星期天是我們安靜的一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quiet means no vacuum, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət minz noʊ ˈvækjum, raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 安靜的意思是不能用吸塵器，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Vacuum goes to Saturday after ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvækjum ɡoʊz tu ˈsætəˌdeɪ ˈæftɚ tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 吸塵器排在星期前十點以後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shoes click on these boards.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ʃuz klɪk ɑn ðiz bɔrdz./
dialogue.zh: 我的鞋在這種地板上會喀喀響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Change to the soft slippers inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃeɪndʒ tu ðə sɔft ˈslɪpɚz ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 在屋裡換成軟拖鞋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which slippers may I use tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈslɪpɚz meɪ aɪ juz təˈnaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我今晚可以穿哪雙拖鞋？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the gray pair, the blue is mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə ɡreɪ pɛr, ðə blu ɪz maɪn./
dialogue.zh: 你拿灰色那雙，藍色是我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gray is warm; gray is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪ ɪz wɔrm; ɡreɪ ɪz faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 灰色很暖，灰色就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more rule: the door stays open.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr rul: ðə dɔr steɪz ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 還有一條：房門要開著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open how much, a crack?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən haʊ mʌtʃ, ə kræk?/
dialogue.zh: 開多少，一條縫嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A hand wide, so air can move.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə hænd waɪd, soʊ ɛr kən muv./
dialogue.zh: 開一掌寬，讓空氣流通。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if the hall gets cold?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf ðə hɔl ɡɛts koʊld?/
dialogue.zh: 如果走道變冷了呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we close it and turn the heat up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi kloʊz ɪt ænd tɜrn ðə hit ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 那我們關上門，把暖氣轉強。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heat costs money, we agreed.
dialogue.phonetic: /hit kɔsts ˈmʌni, wi əˈɡrid./
dialogue.zh: 暖氣要錢，這個我們說好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So wear a sweater, not the dial.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wɛr ə ˈswɛtɚ, nɑt ðə ˈdaɪəl./
dialogue.zh: 所以穿毛衣，別去轉開關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My gray sweater has a hole.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ɡreɪ ˈswɛtɚ hæz ə hoʊl./
dialogue.zh: 我那件灰毛衣上有一個洞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then wear it; it suits a scholar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wɪr ɪt; ɪt suts ə ˈskɑlər./
dialogue.zh: 那就穿吧，很適合讀書人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scholar, huh? That sounds nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈskɑlər, hʌ? ðæt saʊndz naɪs./
dialogue.zh: 讀書人？這說法真好聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You look like one with messy hair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju lʊk laɪk wʌn wɪð ˈmɛsi hɛr./
dialogue.zh: 你頭髮亂亂的，看起來就像。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the clock says ten twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, ðə klɑk sɛz tɛn ˈtwɛnti./
dialogue.zh: 看，時鐘已經十點二十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then hush, and touch that main light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn hʌʃ, ænd tʊtʃ ðæt meɪn laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那小聲點，去關那盞主燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Off. Now the room feels soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔf. naʊ ðə rum filz sɔft./
dialogue.zh: 關了，現在房間變得很柔和。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? Quiet hours are already easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /si? ˈkwaɪət aʊɚz ɑr ɔlˈrɛdi ˈizi./
dialogue.zh: 看到了吧？安靜時段本來就不難。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And now I am hungry again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd naʊ aɪ æm ˈhʌŋɡri əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 而現在我又餓了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a fridge question, tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə frɪdʒ ˈkwɛstʃən, təˈmɑroʊ./
dialogue.zh: 那是冰箱的問題，明天再談。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My eyes are closing, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ aɪz ɑr ˈkloʊzɪŋ, ˈɑnɪstli./
dialogue.zh: 老實說我眼睛快閉上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then sleep, and leave the small lamp on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn slip, ænd liv ðə smɔl læm ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 那就睡吧，小燈留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is off in five minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɔf ɪn faɪv ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 五分鐘後我就關掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, and thanks for the plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt, ænd θæŋks fɔr ðə plæn./
dialogue.zh: 晚安，謝謝你願意一起定規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fridge is almost empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə frɪdʒ ɪz ˈɔlmoʊst ˈɛmpˌti./
dialogue.zh: 冰箱幾乎是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two eggs and one yellow jar.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ɛɡz ænd wʌn ˈjɛloʊ dʒɑr./
dialogue.zh: 兩顆蛋和一個黃色的罐子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whose jar sits in the back?
dialogue.phonetic: /huz dʒɑr sɪts ɪn ðə bæk?/
dialogue.zh: 後面那個罐子是誰的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine, apples from my aunt.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn, ˈæpəlz frʌm maɪ ænt./
dialogue.zh: 我的，我阿姨給的蘋果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will buy milk this afternoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl baɪ mɪlk ðɪs ˈæftɚˌnun./
dialogue.zh: 我今天下午要去買牛奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get two cartons, we drink fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛt tu ˈkɑrtənz, wi drɪŋk fæst./
dialogue.zh: 拿兩盒，我們喝很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Top two shelves are yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɑp tu ʃɛlvz ɑr jɔrz./
dialogue.zh: 上面兩層架子歸你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bottom two are mine, for raw food.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɑtəm tu ɑr maɪn, fɔr rɔ fud./
dialogue.zh: 下面兩層我的，放生食。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Raw food stays far from your apples.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɔ fud steɪz fɑr frʌm jɔr ˈæpəlz./
dialogue.zh: 生食會離你的蘋果遠遠的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, that was my worry last night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, ðæt wʌz maɪ ˈwɝɚ læst naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 好，那是我昨晚擔心的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hand me the tape and the marker.
dialogue.phonetic: /hænd mi ðə teɪp ænd ðə ˈmɑrkɚ./
dialogue.zh: 把膠帶和麥克筆遞給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write names plus the date.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt neɪmz plʌs ðə deɪt./
dialogue.zh: 寫名字，再加日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This yogurt carries no name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈjoɡərt ˈkæriz noʊ neɪm./
dialogue.zh: 這杯優酪乳上沒有名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one is mine, from Monday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn ɪz maɪn, frʌm ˈmʌnˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 那是我的，星期一買的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I cannot know, can I?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ kænɑt noʊ, kæn aɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 那我怎麼分得出來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, put the lid in your half.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri, pʊt ðə lɪd ɪn jɔr hæf./
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，把它放你那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, label it now, both of us.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ˈleɪbəl ɪt naʊ, boʊθ ʌv ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 不，現在就貼標籤，我們兩個都貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, one line: name and day.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn, wʌn laɪn: neɪm ænd deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 好吧，一行就好：名字跟日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, a wrapper on the counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, ə ˈræpɚ ɑn ðə ˈkaʊntɚ./
dialogue.zh: 看，流理台上有一個包裝袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was the lunch box at noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌz ðə lʌntʃ bɑks æt nun./
dialogue.zh: 那是中午的外賣盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I ate it; I am sorry, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ eɪt ɪt; aɪ æm ˈsɑri, ˈtruɪli./
dialogue.zh: 是我吃的，我真的很抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rinse it, then bin it, done.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪns ɪt, ðɛn bɪn ɪt, dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 沖一下再丟掉，就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time the trash is right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm ðə træʃ ɪz raɪt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 下次垃圾桶就在旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under the sink, the small gray one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndɚ ðə sɪŋk, ðə smɔl ɡreɪ wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 水槽下面，那個灰色小的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eggs live on the door shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛɡz lɪv ɑn ðə dɔr ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 雞蛋放在門邊的格子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But the door gets warm, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /bət ðə dɔr ɡɛts wɔrm, ju noʊ./
dialogue.zh: 可是那扇門會變溫，你知道嗎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then move them to the second shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn muv ðɛm tu ðə ˈsɛkənd ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 那把它們移到第二層。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, and write eggs on the tape.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn, ænd raɪt ɛɡz ɑn ðə teɪp./
dialogue.zh: 好了，膠帶上寫雞蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The freezer holds one flat bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈfrisɚ hoʊldz wʌn flæt bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 冷凍庫只放得下一個扁袋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine is soup, from last Sunday.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn ɪz sup, frʌm læst ˈsʌnˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我的那是湯，上星期天煮的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stack ours flat, side by side.
dialogue.phonetic: /stæk aʊrz flæt, saɪd baɪ saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 我們的都壓平、並排放。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then both fit, with space to spare.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn boʊθ fɪt, wɪð speɪs tə spɛr./
dialogue.zh: 那樣兩個都放得下，還有空間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leftovers stay two days, then go.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌlɛftˈoʊvɚz steɪ tu deɪz, ðɛn ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 剩菜留兩天，然後就丟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I agree, my last roommate kept weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ əˈɡri, maɪ læst ˈrumˌmeɪt kɛpt wiks./
dialogue.zh: 我同意，我上個室友會留好幾週。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Something smells from the back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌθɪŋ smɛlz frʌm ðə bæk./
dialogue.zh: 後面有東西壞掉了的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: An old onion, I will reach it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ən oʊld ˈʌnjən, aɪ wɪl ritʃ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 一顆舊洋蔥，我伸手拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wipe the shelf while you are there.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ðə ʃɛlf waɪl ju ɑr ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 既然伸手了就把那層擦一擦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Already wet, the cloth is clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔlˈrɛdi wɛt, ðə klɔθ ɪz klin./
dialogue.zh: 已經擦濕了，布是乾淨的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the cleaning paper, cut it twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə ˈklɪnɪŋ ˈpeɪpɚ, kʌt ɪt twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 現在來把那張清潔表對摺剪開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half for the kitchen, half for the bath.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf fɔr ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn, hæf fɔr ðə bæθ./
dialogue.zh: 一半廚房，一半浴室。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Odd weeks I take the kitchen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑd wiks aɪ teɪk ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn./
dialogue.zh: 單數週我做廚房。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So even weeks the bath is yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈivən wiks ðə bæθ ɪz jɔrz./
dialogue.zh: 那雙數週浴室歸我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flip it then, fair and clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /flɪp ɪt ðɛn, fɛr ænd klɪr./
dialogue.zh: 那就輪替，公平又清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This week you start, today is odd.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wik ju stɑrt, təˈdeɪ ɪz ɑd./
dialogue.zh: 這週你先，今天是單數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, I will not wait till Sunday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt, aɪ wɪl nɑt weɪt tɪl ˈsʌnˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 好，我不會拖到星期天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, the sink scares me.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju, ðə sɪŋk skɛrz mi./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你，那個水槽很嚇人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two sponges, one per job.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈspʌndʒɪz, wʌn pɝ dʒɑb./
dialogue.zh: 兩塊海綿，一塊一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The green one is for the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡrin wʌn ɪz fɔr ðə flɔr./
dialogue.zh: 綠色那塊拖地板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the yellow one for dishes?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈjɛloʊ wʌn fɔr ˈdɪʃɪz?/
dialogue.zh: 黃色的用來洗碗？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, rinse it and squeeze it hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, rɪns ɪt ænd skwiz ɪt hɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 對，用完要沖乾淨再擰乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wipe the stove while it is warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ðə stoʊv waɪl ɪt ɪz wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 爐子還溫的時候就擦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I forgot twice last week, sadly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fɚˈɡɑt twaɪs læst wik, ˈsædli./
dialogue.zh: 上週我很遺憾忘了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then the cloth lives on the handle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə klɔθ lɪvz ɑn ðə ˈhændl./
dialogue.zh: 那抹布就掛在把手上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clever, I will hang mine there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklɛvɚ, aɪ wɪl hæŋ maɪn ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 真聰明，我也掛在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dishes soak, they do not stack.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɪʃɪz soʊk, ðeɪ du nɑt stæk./
dialogue.zh: 碗盤要泡著，不要疊高高。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Whoever cooks tonight, the other washes.
dialogue.phonetic: /huˈɛvɚ kʊks təˈnaɪt, ði ˈʌðɚ ˈwɑʃɪz./
dialogue.zh: 誰煮飯，另一個就洗碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That rule I love the most.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt rul aɪ lʌv ðə moʊst./
dialogue.zh: 我最愛這條規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, no fighting over soap.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn tu, noʊ ˈfaɪtɪŋ ˈoʊvɚ soʊp./
dialogue.zh: 我也是，不用為了肥皂吵架。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You buy soap, I buy bags.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju baɪ soʊp, aɪ baɪ bæɡz./
dialogue.zh: 你買肥皂，我買袋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put the receipts in the jar.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðə rɪˈsits ɪn ðə dʒɑr./
dialogue.zh: 收據放到那個罐子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The glass jar on the top shelf?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡlæs dʒɑr ɑn ðə tɑp ʃɛlf?/
dialogue.zh: 最上面那層的玻璃罐？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we settle it each month.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wi ˈsɛtl ɪt itʃ mʌnθ./
dialogue.zh: 對，我們每個月結一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel I clean more some days.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fil aɪ klin mɔr sʌm deɪz./
dialogue.zh: 有幾天我覺得我比較常在打掃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then read the chart, it never lies.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn rid ðə tʃɑrt, ɪt ˈnɛvɚ laɪz./
dialogue.zh: 那就看輪值表，它不會騙人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair, the paper keeps us honest.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr, ðə ˈpeɪpɚ kips ʌs ˈɑnɪst./
dialogue.zh: 合理，紙本讓我們誠實。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tape it beside the light card.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪp ɪt bɪˈsaɪd ðə laɪt kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 把它貼在燈光卡旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Trash night comes this Wednesday.
dialogue.phonetic: /træʃ naɪt kʌmz ðɪs ˈwɛnzˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 這星期三要倒垃圾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two bags, green and blue.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu bæɡz, ɡrin ænd blu./
dialogue.zh: 兩個袋子，綠的和藍的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I take the heavy green one.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ teɪk ðə ˈhɛvi ɡrin wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 我拿重的綠袋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The blue is recycling only.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə blu ɪz rɪˈsəkəlɪŋ ˈoʊnli./
dialogue.zh: 藍的是純回收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Glass goes in, plastic too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡlæs ɡoʊz ɪn, ˈplæstɪk tu./
dialogue.zh: 玻璃丟進去，塑膠也是。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paper stays dry, please fold it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpɚ steɪz draɪ, pliz foʊld ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 紙要保持乾，拜託摺好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The broom leans behind the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə brum linz bɪˈhaɪnd ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 掃把斜靠在門後。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The mop hides in the tub.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə mɑp haɪdz ɪn ðə tʌb./
dialogue.zh: 拖把藏在浴缸裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lemon soap for the floor, yes?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛmən soʊp fɔr ðə flɔr, jɛs?/
dialogue.zh: 地板用檸檬味的肥皂，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the pine one makes me sneeze.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə paɪn wʌn meɪks mi sniz./
dialogue.zh: 好，松木味的會讓我想打噴嚏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sneeze at ten thirty, that is loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /sniz æt tɛn ˈθɝdi, ðæt ɪz laʊd./
dialogue.zh: 十點半打噴嚏，那很吵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then lemon it is, forever.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈlɛmən ɪt ɪz, fɚˈrɛvɚ./
dialogue.zh: 那就用檸檬味的，永遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Under the bed, dust balls wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndɚ ðə bɛd, dʌst bɔlz weɪt./
dialogue.zh: 床底下有灰塵球在等著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saturday the vacuum visits them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætəˌdeɪ ðə ˈvækjum ˈvɪzɪts ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 星期六吸塵器會去拜訪它們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bag inside it is full.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bæɡ ɪnˈsaɪd ɪt ɪz fʊl./
dialogue.zh: 裡面的集塵袋已經滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then buy two, keep one spare.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn baɪ tu, kip wʌn spɛr./
dialogue.zh: 那就買兩個，留一個備用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your towel today is damp again.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈtaʊəl təˈdeɪ ɪz dæmp əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 妳今天那條毛巾又濕濕的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hang it on the two hooks.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæŋ ɪt ɑn ðə tu hʊks./
dialogue.zh: 掛在那兩個鉤子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only one hook is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli wʌn hʊk ɪz fri./
dialogue.zh: 只剩一個鉤子是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then share mine, we each take a day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ʃɛr maɪn, wi itʃ teɪk ə deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 那共用我的，一人一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mirrors fog when we both shower.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪrɚz fɔɡ wɛn wi boʊθ ˈʃaʊɚ./
dialogue.zh: 我們兩個都洗澡時鏡會起霧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Run the fan ten more minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /rʌn ðə fɛn tɛn mɔr ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 電扇再多開十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That fan is my old friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt fɛn ɪz maɪ oʊld frɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 那台電扇是我的老朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the chart is done for today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə tʃɑrt ɪz dʌn fɔr təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 那今天的規矩就定完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, my socks are on the chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, maɪ sɑks ɑr ɑn ðə tʃɛr./
dialogue.zh: 等等，我的襪子在椅子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which means laundry, my friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ minz ˈlɔndri, maɪ frɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 也就是說要洗衣服了，朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When may I run the machine?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn meɪ aɪ rʌn ðə məˈʃin?/
dialogue.zh: 我幾點可以開洗衣機？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask me first, it is loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk mi fɝst, ɪt ɪz laʊd./
dialogue.zh: 先問我，它聲音很大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then tomorrow, washer hour one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn təˈmɑroʊ, ˈwɑʃɚ aʊɚ wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 那明天第一件就是洗衣時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep now, the chart will wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip naʊ, ðə tʃɑrt wɪl weɪt./
dialogue.zh: 先睡吧，輪值表會等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, the fridge smells lemon now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, ðə frɪdʒ smɛlz ˈlɛmən naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 好，現在冰箱聞起來有檸檬味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was my doing, you are welcome.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌz maɪ ˈduɪŋ, ju ɑr ˈwɛlˌkʌm./
dialogue.zh: 那是我做到的，不客氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow the chart starts for real.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊ ðə tʃɑrt stɑrts fɔr ril./
dialogue.zh: 明天輪值表真的要開始了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the fridge keeps its labels.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ænd ðə frɪdʒ kips ɪts ˈleɪbəlz./
dialogue.zh: 對，冰箱也要一直貼著標籤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the washer at the hall end?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈwɑʃɚ æt ðə hɔl ɛnd?/
dialogue.zh: 洗衣機在走道盡頭嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the second door on the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə ˈsɛkənd dɔr ɑn ðə lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 對，左邊第二個門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it cost anything to use?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ɪt kɔst ˈɛniˌθɪŋ tə juz?/
dialogue.zh: 用一次要錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four coins a load, the cup waits there.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr kɔɪnz ə loʊd, ðə kʌp weɪts ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 一筒四枚硬幣，杯子就放那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we each drop two coins.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi itʃ drɑp tu kɔɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 那我們一人放兩枚進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and no taking them back.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ænd noʊ ˈteɪkɪŋ ðɛm bæk./
dialogue.zh: 對，拿了就不退回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When may I run a load?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn meɪ aɪ rʌn ə loʊd?/
dialogue.zh: 我幾點可以洗衣物？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any time before nine at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni taɪm bɪˈfɔr naɪn æt naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 晚上九點以前任何時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine, because the spin is loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn, bɪˈkɔz ðə spɪn ɪz laʊd./
dialogue.zh: 九點，因為脫水的聲音很大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And quiet hours begin at ten thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ˈkwaɪət aʊɚz bɪˈɡɪn æt tɛn ˈθɝdi./
dialogue.zh: 而且安靜時段十點半開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I wash Tuesday and Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑʃ ˈtuzˌdeɪ ænd ˈfraɪˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我星期二和星期五洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I take Sunday before noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ teɪk ˈsʌnˌdeɪ bɪˈfɔr nun./
dialogue.zh: 我星期中午前洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunday eight is inside quiet hours.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌnˌdeɪ eɪt ɪz ɪnˈsaɪd ˈkwaɪət aʊɚz./
dialogue.zh: 星期天八點還在安靜時段裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet hours end at seven, remember.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət aʊɚz ɛnd æt ˈsɛvən, rɪˈmɛmbɚ./
dialogue.zh: 安靜時段七點結束，記得喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True, so Sunday after eight is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru, soʊ ˈsʌnˌdeɪ ˈæftɚ eɪt ɪz faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，所以星期天八點以後沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring the detergent in your bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ðə dɪˈtɝdʒənt ɪn jɔr bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 把洗衣精放在你的袋子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pods or powder, which do you like?
dialogue.phonetic: /pɑdz ɔr ˈpaʊdɚ, wɪtʃ du ju laɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 洗衣球還是洗衣粉，妳喜歡哪一種？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pods, powder spills across the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɑdz, ˈpaʊdɚ spɪlz əˈkrɔs ðə flɔr./
dialogue.zh: 洗衣球，粉末會灑得到處都是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I buy two boxes next week.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ baɪ tu ˈbɑksɪz nɛkst wik./
dialogue.zh: 我下週買兩盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put them in the tall blue bin.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðɛm ɪn ðə tɔl blu bɪn./
dialogue.zh: 放進那個高高藍色收納箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whose shirt is still inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /huz ʃɜrt ɪz stɪl ɪnˈsaɪd?/
dialogue.zh: 誰的襯衫還留在裡面？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine! I forgot it after dinner.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn! aɪ fɚˈɡɑt ɪt ˈæftɚ ˈdɪnɚ./
dialogue.zh: 我的！我吃完飯就忘了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It smells like a wet dog now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt smɛlz laɪk ə wɛt dɔɡ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 它現在聞起來像濕狗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Run it again, no soap, cold water.
dialogue.phonetic: /rʌn ɪt əˈɡɛn, noʊ sop, koʊld ˈwɔtɚ./
dialogue.zh: 重洗一次，不加肥皂，用冷水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two rinses, then it dries outside?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈrɪnsɪz, ðɛn ɪt draɪz ˈaʊtˌsaɪd?/
dialogue.zh: 沖兩次，然後掛外面曬？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rack inside, rain is coming.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ræk ɪnˈsaɪd, reɪn ɪz ˈkʌmɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 掛室內的衣架，要下雨了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does that rack stand then?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dʌz ðæt ræk stænd ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 那衣架要擺在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My corner, beside the tall shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈkɔrnɚ, bɪˈsaɪd ðə tɔl ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 我的角落，高架子旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half of it is mine to use.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ʌv ɪt ɪz maɪn tə juz./
dialogue.zh: 上面有一半是我的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two bars each, no mixing shirts.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu bɑrz itʃ, noʊ ˈmɪksɪŋ ʃɜrts./
dialogue.zh: 一人兩桿，衣服別混著掛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My white sock came out pink.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ waɪt sɑk keɪm aʊt pɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 我的白襪洗成粉紅色了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Who washed red with white?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu wɑʃt rɛd wɪð waɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 誰把紅的和白的一起洗？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I did, in the dark, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd, ɪn ðə dɑrk, ˈsɑri./
dialogue.zh: 是我，天黑沒看清，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soak them in cold water tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊk ðɛm ɪn koʊld ˈwɔtɚ təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 今晚先泡冷水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pink sheet from the store helps.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɪŋk ʃit frʌm ðə stɔr hɛlps./
dialogue.zh: 商店那種粉紅色吸色片有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy two, we lose socks anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ tu, wi luz sɑks ˈɛniˌweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 買兩包，反正我們老丟襪子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Speaking of socks, one is in mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈspikɪŋ ʌv sɑks, wʌn ɪz ɪn maɪn./
dialogue.zh: 說到襪子，我這裡有一隻別人的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it, it never found a partner.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt, ɪt ˈnɛvɚ faʊnd ə ˈpɑrtnɚ./
dialogue.zh: 給你吧，它從來沒找到另一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gray, with a small blue star.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪ, wɪð ə smɔl blu stɑr./
dialogue.zh: 灰色的，上面有一顆藍小星。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that one lived in my drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðæt wʌn lɪvd ɪn maɪ drɔr./
dialogue.zh: 對，那隻以前住我的抽屜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your wool looked huge this morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr wʊl lʊkt hjudʒ ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 妳那件毛衣今天早上看起來超大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I ran it on hot, my mistake.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ræn ɪt ɑn hɑt, maɪ mɪsˈteɪk./
dialogue.zh: 我用了熱水洗，是我的錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It fits a child now, maybe two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt fɪts ə tʃaɪld naʊ, ˈmeɪbi tu./
dialogue.zh: 現在小得只能給小孩穿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not laugh, I loved that sweater.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt læf, aɪ lʌvd ðæt ˈswɛtɚ./
dialogue.zh: 別笑，我很愛那件毛衣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold water for wool, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld ˈwɔtɚ fɔr wʊl, ˈɔlweɪz./
dialogue.zh: 毛衣永遠用冷水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write that on the machine door.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðæt ɑn ðə məˈʃin dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 把這句寫在洗衣機門上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tape a list there, rules and all.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪp ə lɪst ðɛr, rulz ænd ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 在那裡貼一張清單，規則全寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The dryer eats lint, clean it often.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdraɪɚ its lɪnt, klin ɪt ˈɔfən./
dialogue.zh: 烘衣機吃棉屑，要常清。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who touched the lint trap today?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu tʊtʃt ðə lɪnt træp təˈdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 今天誰動過集塵網？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I did, it was a gray blanket.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd, ɪt wʌz ə ɡreɪ ˈblæŋkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我清的，那是一條灰毛毯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lint makes balls inside my pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪnt meɪks bɔlz ɪnˈsaɪd maɪ ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 棉屑在我口袋裡揉成球。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then carry the small brush.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈkæri ðə smɔl brʌʃ./
dialogue.zh: 那就隨身帶那把小刷子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It knocked twice during the spin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt nɑkt twaɪs ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə spɪn./
dialogue.zh: 脫水時它喀喀響了兩下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coins in the edge, maybe mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔɪnz ɪn ðə ɛdʒ, ˈmeɪbi maɪn./
dialogue.zh: 邊角有硬幣，可能我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not open it, that is risky.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt ˈoʊpən ɪt, ðæt ɪz ˈrɪski./
dialogue.zh: 別自己拆開，那很危險。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The office number sits on the card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɔfɪs ˈnʌmbɚ sɪts ɑn ðə kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 管理室的電話寫在卡上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They charge forty for a visit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ tʃɑrdʒ ˈfɔrti fɔr ə ˈvɪzɪt./
dialogue.zh: 他們來一次收四十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty out of our shared jar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti aʊt ʌv ɑʊr ʃɛrd dʒɑr./
dialogue.zh: 四十從我們公用的罐子出。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will look, it takes one screw.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl lʊk, ɪt teɪks wʌn skru./
dialogue.zh: 我看看，只需轉一顆螺絲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Uncle skills from the print shop?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌŋkəl skɪlz frʌm ðə prɪnt ʃɑp?/
dialogue.zh: 你在印刷店學到的叔叔技藝？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small win: one coin out, done.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl wɪn: wʌn kɔɪn aʊt, dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 小勝利：一枚硬幣拿出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty saved, drop it in the jar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti seɪvd, drɑp ɪt ɪn ðə dʒɑr./
dialogue.zh: 省了四十，丟進罐子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My timer rang, the load is wet.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈtaɪmɚ ræŋ, ðə loʊd ɪz wɛt./
dialogue.zh: 我的計時器響了，衣服還濕的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Carry the basket, do not drip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæri ðə ˈbæskɪt, du nɑt drɪp./
dialogue.zh: 用籃子端過去，別一路滴水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The floor shows a wet line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə flɔr ʃoʊz ə wɛt laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 地板上出現一條濕線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe it with the old cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ɪt wɪð ði oʊld klɔθ./
dialogue.zh: 用那條舊抹布擦一擦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Towels dry fast on the rail.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaʊəlz draɪ fæst ɑn ðə reɪl./
dialogue.zh: 毛巾掛在桿子上乾得快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The hot pipe rail, yes, but careful.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hɑt paɪp reɪl, jɛs, bət ˈkɛrfəl./
dialogue.zh: 是熱水管那桿，小心燙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Iron or fold, which is faster?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaɪərn ɔr foʊld, wɪtʃ ɪz ˈfæstɚ?/
dialogue.zh: 燙衣服還是摺衣服，哪個快？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fold, and you watch something then.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊld, ænd ju wɑtʃ ˈsʌmˌθɪŋ ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 摺，邊看節目邊摺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I match socks while the show runs.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ mætʃ sɑks waɪl ðə ʃoʊ rʌnz./
dialogue.zh: 我邊看節目邊配襪子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are strange, but useful tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr streɪndʒ, bət ˈjusəəl təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 你怪，但今晚很有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shirts on the left, pants on the right.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɜrts ɑn ðə lɛft, pænts ɑn ðə raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 衣服掛左邊，褲子掛右邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both lists are on my door.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ lɪsts ɑr ɑn maɪ dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 兩張清單都貼在我門上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bed sheets take the long slot.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛd ʃits teɪk ðə lɔŋ slɑt./
dialogue.zh: 床單要排那個長時段。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hour, then you move yours out.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn aʊɚr, ðɛn ju muv jɔrz aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 一小時，之後換你的出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunday we change both of them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌnˌdeɪ wi tʃeɪndʒ boʊθ ʌv ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 星期天我們兩張床都換。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smell the pillow first, then decide.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɛl ðə ˈpɪloʊ fɝst, ðɛn dɪˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 先聞聞枕頭再決定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bag is half empty now.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bæɡ ɪz hæf ˈɛmpˌti naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我的髒衣袋現在一半空了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine has two clean sets left.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn hæz tu klin sɛts lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 我的還剩兩套乾淨的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When you are low, tell me first.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn ju ɑr loʊ, tɛl mi fɝst./
dialogue.zh: 妳衣服不夠時先告訴我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, I hate borrowing shirts.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil, aɪ heɪt ˈbɑroʊɪŋ ʃɜrts./
dialogue.zh: 好，我最討厭借襯衫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Borrowing is fine, asking is the rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɑroʊɪŋ ɪz faɪn, ˈæskɪŋ ɪz ðə rul./
dialogue.zh: 借沒關係，問過才是規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You pass the test, roommate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju pæs ðə tɛst, ˈrumˌeɪt./
dialogue.zh: 你及格了，室友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The machine hums, the light is green.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə məˈʃin hʌmz, ðə laɪt ɪz ɡrin./
dialogue.zh: 洗衣機嗡嗡響，燈變綠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes, then we wait here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts, ðɛn wi weɪt hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘，然後我們在這等？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, we rest, my feet hurt.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, wi rɛst, maɪ fit hɜrt./
dialogue.zh: 不了，我們去坐一下，腳痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chairs by the window, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tʃɛrz baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ, ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那就坐窗邊那兩張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am hungry, to be honest.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈhʌŋɡri, tə bi ˈɑnɪst./
dialogue.zh: 說實話我有點餓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too; my last bite was noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /mi tu; maɪ læst baɪt wʌz nun./
dialogue.zh: 我也是，我最後一口是中午。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is one noodle pack left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz wʌn ˈnudəl pæk lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 還剩一包麵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two eggs wait on the second shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ɛɡz weɪt ɑn ðə ˈsɛkənd ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 兩顆蛋在第二層等著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Boil water, I chop the greens.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɔɪl ˈwɔtɚ, aɪ tʃɑp ðə ɡrinz./
dialogue.zh: 水燒開，我切青菜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the small pot, the dented one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə smɔl pɑt, ðə ˈdɛntɪd wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 用那個有小凹角的鍋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That pot is mine, from home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt pɑt ɪz maɪn, frʌm hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 那鍋子是我從家裡帶來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we share it, as always.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi ʃɛr ɪt, æz ˈɔlweɪz./
dialogue.zh: 那我們共用，一直這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is already ten forty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi tɛn ˈfɔrti./
dialogue.zh: 已經十點四十了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then quietly, in socks, no shoes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈkwaɪətli, ɪn sɑks, noʊ ʃuz./
dialogue.zh: 那小聲點，穿襪子別穿鞋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set the table with two spoons.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ðə ˈteɪbəl wɪð tu spunz./
dialogue.zh: 擺兩個湯匙在桌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One big bowl, split down the middle.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn bɪɡ boʊl, splɪt daʊn ðə ˈmɪdəl./
dialogue.zh: 一個大碗，從中間分給兩個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The water is loud now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɔtɚ ɪz laʊd naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 水現在滾得很吵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put the noodles in, one at a time.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðə ˈnudəlz ɪn, wʌn æt ə taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 把麵放進去，一次一把。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stir twice, the pack says three minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɜr twaɪs, ðə pæk sɛz θri ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 攪兩次，包裝上寫三分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set your phone, I lost track.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt jɔr foʊn, aɪ lɔst træk./
dialogue.zh: 用你手機計時，我忘記時間了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No salt yet, the pack has a bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ sɔlt jɛt, ðə pæk hæz ə bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 先別加鹽，包裝裡有一包調料。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use half, the rest stays in the tin.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz hæf, ðə rɛst steɪz ɪn ðə tɪn./
dialogue.zh: 用一半，剩下的放進鐵罐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, the steam bites.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrfəl, ðə stim baɪts./
dialogue.zh: 小心，蒸氣會咬人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I burned my thumb on the lid.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ bɜrnd maɪ θʌm ɑn ðə lɪd./
dialogue.zh: 我拇指被鍋蓋燙到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold water on it, right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld ˈwɔtɚ ɑn ɪt, raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 趕快用冷水沖一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better. Now the egg, soft or hard?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtɚ. naʊ ði ɛɡ, sɔft ɔr hɑrd?/
dialogue.zh: 好多了。蛋要軟的還是硬的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soft, with the middle still wet.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft, wɪð ðə ˈmɪdəl stɪl wɛt./
dialogue.zh: 軟的，中心還濕的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then four minutes, the timer again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn fɔr ˈmɪnɪts, ðə ˈtaɪmɚ əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那四分鐘，又要用計時器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Crack it on the spoon, not the pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /kræk ɪt ɑn ðə spun, nɑt ðə pɑt./
