dialogue.zh: 在湯匙上敲蛋，別敲鍋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My mother does that, watch the shell.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈmʌðɚ dʌz ðæt, wɑtʃ ðə ʃɛl./
dialogue.zh: 我媽媽都這樣做，注意蛋殼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shell in my soup, classic me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɛl ɪn maɪ sup, ˈklæsɪk mi./
dialogue.zh: 湯裡有蛋殼，我就這麼倒霉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fish it out with the edge of a spoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪʃ ɪt aʊt wɪð ði ɛdʒ ʌv ə spun./
dialogue.zh: 用湯匙邊把它撈出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Greens last, thirty seconds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡrinz læst, ˈθɜrti ˈsɛkəndz./
dialogue.zh: 青菜最後放，三十秒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From the door shelf, the sad ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /frʌm ðə dɔr ʃɛlf, ðə sæd wʌnz./
dialogue.zh: 從門邊那層拿，有點蔫了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chili? The red jar or none.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃɪli? ðə rɛd dʒɑr ɔr nʌn./
dialogue.zh: 辣椒？要紅罐子的還是不放？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You know I love the red one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju noʊ aɪ lʌv ðə rɛd wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 你知道我愛那個紅的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two spoons of it, then you cry.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu spʌnz ʌv ɪt, ðɛn ju kraɪ./
dialogue.zh: 只加兩匙，不然你會哭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I cried once, and I asked for more.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kraɪd wʌns, ænd aɪ æskt fɔr mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我哭過一次，然後又要加。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The label says beef, not pork.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈleɪbəl sɛz bif, nɑt pɔrk./
dialogue.zh: 標條寫牛肉，不是豬肉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I read it twice, I promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ rɛd ɪt twaɪs, aɪ ˈprɑmɪs./
dialogue.zh: 我看了兩遍，我保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, my family does not eat pork.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks, maɪ ˈfæməli dʌz nɑt it pɔrk./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我家不吃豬肉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rule learned, written on the chart.
dialogue.phonetic: /rul lɜrnd, ˈrɪtn ɑn ðə tʃɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 記下了，寫在輪值表上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the box with the fragile bowl?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ðə bɑks wɪð ðə ˈfrædʒəl boʊl?/
dialogue.zh: 這是那個裝易碎碗的箱子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My mother's bowl; we share one soup.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈmʌðɚz boʊl; wi ʃɛr wʌn sup./
dialogue.zh: 我媽媽給的碗，我們共用一碗湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Split down the middle, two spoons.
dialogue.phonetic: /splɪt daʊn ðə ˈmɪdəl, tu spunz./
dialogue.zh: 從中間分一半，兩支湯匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like kids at the table, huh.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk kɪdz æt ðə ˈteɪbəl, hʌk./
dialogue.zh: 像兩個小孩在桌邊，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too salty. I can taste the tin.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈsɔlti. aɪ kæn test ðə tɪn./
dialogue.zh: 太鹹了，我喝到罐頭味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add water, one ladle, slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd ˈwɔtɚ, wʌn ˈlædəl, ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 加水，一瓢一瓢慢慢加。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still salty. My face knows.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl ˈsɔlti. maɪ feɪs noʊz./
dialogue.zh: 還是很鹹，我皺眉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The potato trick, my aunt's trick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pəˈteɪtoʊ trɪk, maɪ ænts trɪk./
dialogue.zh: 馬鈴薯撇鹽，我阿姨的方法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We have no raw potato here.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv noʊ rɔ pəˈteɪtoʊ hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我們這裡沒有生馬鈴薯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then bread, a piece, in the soup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn brɛd, ə pis, ɪn ðə sup./
dialogue.zh: 那就面包，撕一塊放湯裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bread soup? That is new to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɛd sup? ðæt ɪz nju tu mi./
dialogue.zh: 面包湯？這我沒試過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It drinks the salt. Try a spoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt drɪŋks ðə sɔlt. traɪ ə spun./
dialogue.zh: 它會吸走鹽，試一匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better. You cook, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtɚ. ju kʊk, ˈæktʃuəli./
dialogue.zh: 變好了，其實你很會煮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three roommates told me that.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈrumˌmeɪts toʊld mi ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 三個室友都這樣跟我說過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The chopsticks live where? Show me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtʃɑpˌstɪks lɪv wɛr? ʃoʊ mi./
dialogue.zh: 筷子放在哪裡？給我看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Second drawer, next to the forks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛkənd drɔr, nɛkst tu ðə fɔrks./
dialogue.zh: 第二個抽屜，叉子旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One pair, washed, of course.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn pɛr, wɑʃt, ʌv kɔrs./
dialogue.zh: 一雙，先洗過，當然。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The last roommate left six pairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læst ˈrumˌmeɪt lɛft sɪks pɛrz./
dialogue.zh: 上個室友留了六雙筷子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free chopsticks, the best news.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri ˈtʃɑpˌstɪks, ðə bɛst nuz./
dialogue.zh: 白送的筷子，最好的消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wash the drawer too, chart says so.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑʃ ðə drɔr tu, tʃɑrt sɛz soʊ./
dialogue.zh: 抽屜也要擦，表上這樣寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The chart follows me home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tʃɑrt ˈfɑloʊz mi hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 那張表追著我到家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sits beside the door, like a judge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɪts bɪˈsaɪd ðə dɔr, laɪk ə dʒʌdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 它坐在門邊，像法官。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sit, the bowl waits, it steams.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt, ðə boʊl weɪts, ɪt stimz./
dialogue.zh: 坐吧，碗在等你，還冒煙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First spoon is yours, you stirred.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɝst spun ɪz jɔrz, ju stɜrd./
dialogue.zh: 第一匙給你，你攪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You cracked the egg, you take two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju krækt ði ɛɡ, ju teɪk tu./
dialogue.zh: 是妳敲蛋的，那給你兩匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal. Now hush, we eat hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil. naʊ hʌʃ, wi it hɑt./
dialogue.zh: 好，現在安靜，趁熱吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rain stopped, look at the glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪn stɑpt, lʊk æt ðə ɡlæs./
dialogue.zh: 雨停了，看看窗玻璃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The window is fog from the pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ɪz fɑɡ frʌm ðə pɑt./
dialogue.zh: 窗上的霧是鍋氣弄的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My tongue is numb already.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ tʌŋ ɪz nʌm ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 我的舌頭都麻了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You ate three spoons in a row.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju eɪt θri spunz ɪn ə roʊ./
dialogue.zh: 你連吃了三匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This beats the dining hall tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs bits ðə ˈdaɪnɪŋ hɔl treɪ./
dialogue.zh: 這比學校餐廳的托盤餐好吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tray lost my respect in week one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə treɪ lɔst maɪ rɪˈspɛkt ɪn wik wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 第一週我就看不起那個托盤了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Home soup was different, with fish.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊm sup wʌz ˈdɪfɚənt, wɪð fɪʃ./
dialogue.zh: 家裡的湯不一樣，是魚湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Teach me that in the summer.
dialogue.phonetic: /titʃ mi ðæt ɪn ðə ˈsʌmɚ./
dialogue.zh: 夏天教我煮那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My mother made it by the sea.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈmʌðɚ meɪd ɪt baɪ ðə si./
dialogue.zh: 我媽媽在海邊煮給我吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I bring rice, and we try.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ brɪŋ raɪs, ænd wi traɪ./
dialogue.zh: 那我帶米，我們試試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The garlic next, if you dare.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈɡɑrlɪk nɛkst, ɪf ju dɛr./
dialogue.zh: 接下來是蒜，你敢嗎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dare. I have soap for that.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɛr. aɪ hæv soʊp fɔr ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 敢，我有肥皂可以洗手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your soup smell lives on the couch.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr sup smɛl lɪvz ɑn ðə kaʊtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 湯的味道住在沙發上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open the window one hand wide.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ðə ˈwɪndoʊ wʌn hænd waɪd./
dialogue.zh: 窗戶開一掌寬就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold air comes in fast here.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld ɛr kʌmz ɪn fæst hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 這裡冷風進來很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then a small crack, and we cover up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ə smɔl kræk, ænd wi ˈkʌvɚ ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 那就開一條縫，然後蓋被子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blankets, spoons, and the last bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈblæŋkɪts, spunz, ænd ðə læst bɪt./
dialogue.zh: 毯子、湯匙，還有最後一口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave one spoon for the pot, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv wʌn spun fɔr ðə pɑt, pliz./
dialogue.zh: 請留一匙在鍋子旁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We are full, in a good way.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɑr fʊl, ɪn ə ɡʊd weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我們吃飽了，是舒服的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your face says it, soft and round.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr feɪs sɛz ɪt, sɔft ænd raʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 你的臉說得很清楚，圓圓的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Round is rude, you know that.
dialogue.phonetic: /raʊnd ɪz rud, ju noʊ ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 說人臉圓很不禮貌耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Round is happy, from soup.
dialogue.phonetic: /raʊnd ɪz ˈhæpi, frʌm sup./
dialogue.zh: 圓是開心的圓，因為湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who washes? The chart has a rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /hu ˈwɑʃɪz? ðə tʃɑrt hæz ə rul./
dialogue.zh: 誰洗碗？輪值表有規定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We both cooked, so both of us wash.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi boʊθ kʊkt, soʊ boʊθ ʌv ʌs wɑʃ./
dialogue.zh: 我們兩個都煮了，所以一起洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You dry, I scrub the pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju draɪ, aɪ skrʌb ðə pɑt./
dialogue.zh: 妳擦，我刷鍋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soak it first, ten minutes, remember.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊk ɪt fɝst, tɛn ˈmɪnɪts, rɪˈmɛmbɚ./
dialogue.zh: 先泡十分鐘，記得喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tin in the sink, lid aside.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɪn ɪn ðə sɪŋk, lɪd əˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 調料罐放水槽，鍋蓋放旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sponge is yellow, that is dishes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə spʌndʒ ɪz ˈjɛloʊ, ðæt ɪz ˈdɪʃɪz./
dialogue.zh: 黃色那塊海綿是洗碗的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I remember the green floor one.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ rɪˈmɛmbɚ ðə ɡrin flɔr wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 我記得綠色那塊是地板的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not mix them, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt mɪks ðɛm, θæŋk ju./
dialogue.zh: 別混用，謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tea now, or bed now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ti naʊ, ɔr bɛd naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 現在喝茶，還是現在睡覺？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tea, then bed, in that order.
dialogue.phonetic: /ti, ðɛn bɛd, ɪn ðæt ˈɔrdɚ./
dialogue.zh: 先茶後床，這個順序。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The last bag from my box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læst bæɡ frʌm maɪ bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 這是我箱子裡最後一包茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your box had secrets, I see.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr bɑks hæd ˈsikrɪts, aɪ si./
dialogue.zh: 你箱子裡有寶藏，我看到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sugar, no milk, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃʊɡɚ, noʊ mɪlk, raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 糖不加奶，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, and one cookie each.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, ænd wʌn ˈkʊki itʃ./
dialogue.zh: 對，餅乾一人一塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cookies at eleven, the chart approves.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʊkiz æt ɪˈlɛvən, ðə tʃɑrt əˈpruvz./
dialogue.zh: 十一點吃餅乾，輪值表准許。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chart knows nothing, it is paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tʃɑrt noʊz ˈnʌθɪŋ, ɪt ɪz ˈpeɪpɚ./
dialogue.zh: 那張表什麼都不知道，它只是紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday nights: soup in this room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfraɪˌdeɪ naɪts: sup ɪn ðɪs rum./
dialogue.zh: 星期五晚上：在房間煮湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put it on the calendar, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ɪt ɑn ðə ˈkæləndɚ, pliz./
dialogue.zh: 請把它寫到行事曆上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: With my brother coming Saturday.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð maɪ ˈbrʌðɚ ˈkʌmɪŋ ˈsætəˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我哥哥星期六要來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your brother? We need a talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈbrʌðɚ? wi nid ə tɔk./
dialogue.zh: 你哥哥？我們得談談來客的規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Guest rules, you are right.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛst rulz, ju ɑr raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 客人的規矩，你說得對。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell me now, before he packs.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi naʊ, bɪˈfɔr hi pæks./
dialogue.zh: 現在就說，在他收行李之前。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep first, guests can wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip fɝst, ɡɛsts kæn weɪt./
dialogue.zh: 先睡吧，客人可以再等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, sit, I want this chart too.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, sɪt, aɪ wɑnt ðɪs tʃɑrt tu./
dialogue.zh: 不，坐下來，我也想把表寫完整。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we write the guest half now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi raɪt ðə ɡɛst hæf naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 那我們現在就把客人那半頁寫出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With tea, and no more cooking.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð ti, ænd noʊ mɔr ˈkʊkɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 配茶，今晚不再煮東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My friend Mei asks about Tuesday.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ frɛnd meɪ æks əˈbaʊt ˈtuzˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我朋友小梅問星期二可不可以來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuesday is a study night for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtuzˌdeɪ ɪz ə ˈstʌdi naɪt fɔr mi./
dialogue.zh: 星期二是我的讀書夜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She can leave by ten thirty, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi kæn liv baɪ tɛn ˈθɝdi, ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那她十點半以前離開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the exact hour I start.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ði ɪɡˈzækt aʊɚr aɪ stɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 那個時間正是我要開始的時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Text me before five, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst mi bɪˈfɔr faɪv, ˈɔlweɪz./
dialogue.zh: 五點以前先傳訊息給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One day ahead, that is rule one.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn deɪ əˈhɛd, ðæt ɪz rul wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 提前一天，這就第一條規則。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the shoes at the door?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə ʃuz æt ðə dɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 門口的鞋子怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Guests take them off, like us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛsts teɪk ðɛm ɔf, laɪk ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 客人要跟我們一樣脫鞋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We have one guest chair only.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv wʌn ɡɛst tʃɛr ˈoʊnli./
dialogue.zh: 我們只有一張客人椅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The folding one lives in the closet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈfoʊldɪŋ wʌn lɪvz ɪn ðə ˈklɑzət./
dialogue.zh: 那張摺疊椅放在衣櫃裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It sticks in the summer, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stɪks ɪn ðə ˈsʌmɚ, ju noʊ./
dialogue.zh: 夏天的時候它會卡住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then oil it, or take the stool.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɔɪl ɪt, ɔr teɪk ðə stul./
dialogue.zh: 那就上油，不然拿凳子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The kitchen closes at ten thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn ˈkloʊzɪz æt tɛn ˈθɝdi./
dialogue.zh: 廚房十點半以後不給用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No cooking with company, got it.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈkʊkɪŋ wɪð ˈkʌmpəni, ɡɑt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 有客人時不煮飯，知道了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tea is not cooking, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ti ɪz nɑt ˈkʊkɪŋ, raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 泡茶不算煮飯，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kettle only, and wash the cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛtl ˈoʊnli, ænd wɑʃ ðə kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 只能燒水，用完杯子要洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mei is early, I hear the bell.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ ɪz ˈɜrli, aɪ hɪr ðə bɛl./
dialogue.zh: 小梅好早到，我聽到電鈴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press three B, not the big gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs θri bi, nɑt ðə bɪɡ ɡeɪt./
dialogue.zh: 按三B，不要按大門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She pulled the gate twice already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi pʊld ðə ɡeɪt twaɪs ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 她已經拉了大門兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The buzzer card is on the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈbʌzɚ kɑrd ɪz ɑn ðə wɔl./
dialogue.zh: 對講那張卡就貼在牆上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, Mei, shoes off, sorry about that.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ, meɪ, ʃuz ɔf, ˈsɑri əˈbaʊt ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 嗨，小梅，鞋脫一下，不好意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rule one, and she will learn it.
dialogue.phonetic: /rul wʌn, ænd ʃi wɪl lɜrn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 這是第一條，她一下子就學會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tea, then my study hour starts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ti, ðɛn maɪ ˈstʌdi aʊɚr stɑrts./
dialogue.zh: 先喝茶，然後我要開始念書。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will whisper, me and Mei.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪl ˈwɪspɚ, mi ænd meɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我跟小梅會小聲說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten twenty already, she talks loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈtwɛnti ɔlˈrɛdi, ʃi tɔks laʊd./
dialogue.zh: 已經十點二十，她講得很大聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will walk her to the stair door.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl wɔk hɜr tu ðə stɛr dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我陪她走到樓梯口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not push her out, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt pʊʃ hɜr aʊt, pliz./
dialogue.zh: 拜託別把她趕走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the hall, we need quiet here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðə hɔl, wi nid ˈkwaɪət hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 只是走到走道，我們這裡要安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, my hour is tomorrow at eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri, maɪ aʊɚr ɪz təˈmɑroʊ æt eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我明天八點有課。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We set it early for that.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi sɛt ɪt ˈɝli fɔr ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 我們就是為了那個才排早。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How was the whisper night?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ wʌz ðə ˈwɪspɚ naɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 那晚小聲聊天聊得怎樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loud at first, then a good talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /laʊd æt fɝst, ðɛn ə ɡʊd tɔk./
dialogue.zh: 開始很吵，後來聊得很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did she touch the labeled yogurt?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ʃi tʊtʃ ðə ˈlæbld ˈjoɡərt?/
dialogue.zh: 她有動到貼標籤的優格嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, she asked about the tape first.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ʃi æskt əˈbaʊt ðə teɪp fɝst./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，她先問那個膠帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our labels travel, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊr ˈleɪbəlz ˈtrævəl, ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 我們的標籤會傳出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her flat has no labels at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜr flæt hæz noʊ ˈleɪbəlz æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 她住的房間一張標籤都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then teach them, she seems nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn titʃ ðɛm, ʃi simz naɪs./
dialogue.zh: 那就教她，她看起來很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Monday she comes again, is that okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌnˌdeɪ ʃi kʌmz əˈɡɛn, ɪz ðæt oʊˈkeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 她星期一還要來，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Monday is clean night, kitchen only.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌnˌdeɪ ɪz klin naɪt, ˈkɪtʃɪn ˈoʊnli./
dialogue.zh: 星期一該清潔，只用廚房。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She can help wash, if you want.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi kæn hɛlp wɑʃ, ɪf ju wɑnt./
dialogue.zh: 如果你願意，她可以幫忙洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My brother Ken comes Saturday.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈbrʌðɚ kɛn kʌmz ˈsætəˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我哥哥肯星期六要來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: After your shift, so after six?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæftɚ jɔr ʃɪft, soʊ ˈæftɚ sɪks?/
dialogue.zh: 你打工之後，也就是六點以後？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He sleeps on the couch, one night.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi slips ɑn ðə kaʊtʃ, wʌn naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 他睡沙發，只有一晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two nights a week, that is rule two.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu naɪts ə wik, ðæt ɪz rul tu./
dialogue.zh: 一週最多兩晚，這是第二條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One only, I promise you that.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈoʊnli, aɪ ˈprɑmɪs ju ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 就一晚，我跟你保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Towels count double, he uses three.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaʊəlz kaʊnt ˈdʌbəl, hi ˈjuzɪz θri./
dialogue.zh: 毛巾要算兩倍，他會用三條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He is a big guy, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ɪz ə bɪɡ ɡaɪ, ˈsɑri./
dialogue.zh: 他塊頭很大，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give him the green towel, not mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡiv hɪm ðə ɡrin ˈtaʊəl, nɑt maɪn./
dialogue.zh: 給他綠色那條，別給我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The blue one is his, from the store.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə blu wʌn ɪz hɪz, frʌm ðə stɔr./
dialogue.zh: 藍色那條是他自己買的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy two more, we share the jar.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ tu mɔr, wi ʃɛr ðə dʒɑr./
dialogue.zh: 再買兩條，錢從罐子出。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ken eats without asking, sadly.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɛn its wɪˈðaʊt ˈæskɪŋ, ˈsædli./
dialogue.zh: 肯都不問就亂吃東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then hide the labeled yogurt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn haɪd ðə ˈlæbld ˈjoɡərt./
dialogue.zh: 那就把有標籤的優格收起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He ate mine, the one with Monday.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi eɪt maɪn, ðə wʌn wɪð ˈmʌnˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 他吃了我那杯，寫星期的那杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then he washes the pot, rule three.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn hi ˈwɑʃɪz ðə pɑt, rul θri./
dialogue.zh: 那他就要洗鍋，第三條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rule three is mine to write?
dialogue.phonetic: /rul θri ɪz maɪ tə raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 第三條由我來寫？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, you host, so you clean tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ju hoʊst, soʊ ju klin təˈmɑroʊ./
dialogue.zh: 不，你是主人，所以你明天打掃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whoever invites, cleans tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /huˈɛvɚ ɪnˈvaɪts, klinz təˈmɑroʊ./
dialogue.zh: 誰邀請，誰隔天打掃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ken can sweep, he owes you now.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɛn kæn swip, hi oʊz ju naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 肯可以掃地，他欠你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three guests in one small room?
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ɡɛsts ɪn wʌn smɔl rum?/
dialogue.zh: 三個客人擠一間小房間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rule four: three heads, no parties.
dialogue.phonetic: /rul fɔr: θri hɛdz, noʊ ˈpɑrtiz./
dialogue.zh: 第四條：最多三人，不辦派對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And no loud music past ten thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd noʊ laʊd ˈmjuzɪk pæst tɛn ˈθɝdi./
dialogue.zh: 十點半以後也不能大聲放音樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That hour is our wall already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt aʊɚr ɪz ɑʊr wɔl ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 那個時間本來就是我們的牆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ken left his charger again.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɛn lɛft hɪz ˈtʃɑrdʒɚ əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 肯又把充電線留下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The white one on the desk shelf?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə waɪt wʌn ɑn ðə dɛsk ʃɛlf?/
dialogue.zh: 書架那層那條白的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, he takes it every time.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, hi ˈteɪks ɪt ˈɛvri taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 對，他每次都拿走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Label it, tape says Ken is blind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈleɪbəl ɪt, teɪp sɛz kɛn ɪz blaɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 貼標籤，寫說肯看不見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write on the tape, do not laugh.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ɑn ðə teɪp, du nɑt læf./
dialogue.zh: 寫在膠帶上，別笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I laughed a little, sorry, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ læft ə ˈlɪtəl, ˈsɑri, ˈtruɪli./
dialogue.zh: 我小笑了一下，真的抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He also drank the soy milk.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ˈɔlsoʊ dræŋk ðə sɔɪ mɪlk./
dialogue.zh: 他還喝掉了豆漿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The carton you bought Wednesday?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɑrtən ju bɔt ˈwɛnzˌdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 你星期三買的那盒？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and he left the empty one.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ænd hi lɛft ði ˈɛmpˌti wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 對，他把空盒子留下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rinse, bin, and tell him gently.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪns, bɪn, ænd tɛl hɪm ˈdʒɛntli./
dialogue.zh: 沖一下、丟掉，然後好聲跟他說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday he arrives past seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætəˌdeɪ hi əˈraɪvz pæst ˈsɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 他星期六七點多才到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then he can join the table talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn hi kæn dʒɔɪn ðə ˈteɪbəl tɔk./
dialogue.zh: 那他可以加入我們桌邊聊天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three bowls, then one big pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri boʊlz, ðɛn wʌn bɪɡ pɑt./
dialogue.zh: 三個碗，然後一大鍋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He washes all three, that is fair.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ˈwɑʃɪz ɔl θri, ðæt ɪz fɛr./
dialogue.zh: 他三個都洗，這才公平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Guests sleep on the couch, never in the room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛsts slip ɑn ðə kaʊtʃ, ˈnɛvɚ ɪn ðə rum./
dialogue.zh: 客人睡沙發，絕不睡我們房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ken was glad, he slept like a log.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɛn wʌz ɡlæd, hi slɛpt laɪk ə lɑɡ./
dialogue.zh: 肯很高興，他睡得像塊木頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the blanket stays on him.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈblæŋkɪt steɪz ɑn hɪm./
dialogue.zh: 毯子也要留給他蓋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He snores, you know that now.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi snɔrz, ju noʊ ðæt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 他打呼，你現在見識過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two strangers knocked last night.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈstreɪndʒɚz nɑkt læst naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 昨天晚上有兩個人來敲門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your club friends, I saw the photo.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr klʌb frɛndz, aɪ sɔ ðə ˈfoʊtoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 是你社團的朋友，我看到照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I told them to text first.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ toʊld ðɛm tə tɛkst fɝst./
dialogue.zh: 我已經叫他們先傳訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They laughed at the card by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ læft æt ðə kɑrd baɪ ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 他們笑門邊那張卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our card is famous, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊr kɑrd ɪz ˈfeɪməs, ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那我們的卡片出名了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mei wants one for her flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ wɑnts wʌn fɔr hɜr flæt./
dialogue.zh: 小梅想幫她房間也做一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Copy ours, we will write it twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑpi aʊrz, wi wɪl raɪt ɪt twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 抄我們的，我們寫兩份。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rules: text, shoes, tea, three heads.
dialogue.phonetic: /rulz: tɛkst, ʃuz, ti, θri hɛdz./
dialogue.zh: 規則：先訊息、脫鞋、茶、三人上限。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And no borrowed towels, rule five.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd noʊ ˈbɑroʊd ˈtaʊəlz, rul faɪv./
dialogue.zh: 還有不可以借毛巾，第五條。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ken took mine to the station.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɛn tʊk maɪn tu ðə ˈsteɪʃən./
dialogue.zh: 肯把我的那條帶去車站了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bus station? Why?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bʌs ˈsteɪʃən? waɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 客運站？為什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His bag got wet, poor guy.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪz bæɡ ɡɑt wɛt, pʊr ɡaɪ./
dialogue.zh: 他的袋子淋濕了，可憐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then he may keep that one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn hi meɪ kip ðæt wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 那就讓他那條留著吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are kind when you are tired.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr kaɪnd wɛn ju ɑr ˈtaɪərd./
dialogue.zh: 你累的時候反而很體貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday with guests, Sunday quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætəˌdeɪ wɪð ɡɛsts, ˈsʌnˌdeɪ ˈkwaɪət./
dialogue.zh: 星期六招待客人，星期天安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That balance keeps me sane here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈbæləns kips mi seɪn hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 這樣平衡讓我在這裡撐得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The guest list is full now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡɛst lɪst ɪz fʊl naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 客人規則現在寫滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Except the key question, still open.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈsɛpt ðə ki ˈkwɛstʃən, stɪl ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 除了鑰匙那題還沒結。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does our spare key live?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dʌz ɑʊr spɛr ki lɪv?/
dialogue.zh: 我們的備用鑰匙放哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the blue box, with the code.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə blu bɑks, wɪð ðə kod./
dialogue.zh: 在藍色小盒子裡，還有密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our spare key sits in the blue box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊr spɛr ki sɪts ɪn ðə blu bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 我們的備用鑰匙放在藍色小盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The small one beside the door frame.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə smɔl wʌn bɪˈsaɪd ðə dɔr freɪm./
dialogue.zh: 門邊框旁邊那個小的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never write the code on the tag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvɚ raɪt ðə kod ɑn ðə tæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 絕對不要把密碼寫在牌子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I keep it in my head, mostly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kip ɪt ɪn maɪ hɛd, ˈmoʊstli./
dialogue.zh: 我大部分都記在腦袋裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two copies, one for each bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈkɑpiz, wʌn fɔr itʃ bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 配兩把，每個包一把。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shop on Fifth cuts them fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɑp ɑn fɪfθ kʌts ðɛm fæst./
dialogue.zh: 五號店那家複製得很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two dollars apiece, from the jar.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈdɑlɚz əˈpis, frʌm ðə dʒɑr./
dialogue.zh: 一把兩塊，從罐子裡拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cheap, compared with a locked night.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃip, kəmˈpɛrd wɪð ə lɑkt naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 比起被鎖在外面便宜多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not hide a key under the mat.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt haɪd ə ki ˈʌndɚ ðə mæt./
dialogue.zh: 不要把鑰匙藏在門墊下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The last tenant did, and lost a rug.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læst ˈtɛntənt dɪd, ænd lɔst ə rʌɡ./
dialogue.zh: 上一個租客就是這樣，還弄丟了一塊地毯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who keeps the third copy, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu kips ðə θɝd ˈkɑpi, ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 那第三把誰收著？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The office, in an envelope, sealed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɔfɪs, ɪn ən ɪnˈvɛləˌpi, sild./
dialogue.zh: 管理室，裝在信封裡，封起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the notes, on the fridge door.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə noʊts, ɑn ðə frɪdʒ dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 再來是紙條，貼在冰箱門上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With the cat magnet, the heavy one.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð ðə kæt ˈmæɡnət, ði ˈhɛvi wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 用那個貓咪磁鐵，很重的那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paper lives behind the milk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpɚ lɪvz bɪˈhaɪnd ðə mɪlk./
dialogue.zh: 紙就放在牛奶後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small sheets, cut from the old chart.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl ʃits, kʌt frʌm ði oʊld tʃɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 小張的，從舊表格剪下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The marker is dry again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɑrkɚ ɪz draɪ əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 麥克筆又沒水了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a pencil in the cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə ˈpɛnsəl ɪn ðə kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 杯子裡還有一枝鉛筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pencil notes fade in the rain.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɛnsəl noʊts feɪd ɪn ðə reɪn./
dialogue.zh: 鉛筆寫的紙條會因濕而淡掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then press hard, and date it too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn prɛs hɑrd, ænd deɪt ɪt tu./
dialogue.zh: 那就用力寫，也要寫日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rule: if I am asleep, write.
dialogue.phonetic: /rul: ɪf aɪ æm əˈslip, raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 規矩：如果我睡了，就寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And if it is urgent, knock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf ɪt ɪz ˈɜrdʒənt, nɑk./
dialogue.zh: 如果很急，就敲門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many knocks is urgent?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni nɑks ɪz ˈɜrdʒənt?/
dialogue.zh: 敲幾下算很急？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three fast ones, then I am up.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri fæst wʌnz, ðɛn aɪ æm ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 快速三下，我就會起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I leave Friday, home for two days.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ liv ˈfraɪˌdeɪ, hoʊm fɔr tu deɪz./
dialogue.zh: 我星期五走，回家兩天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write me a note, or I forget.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt mi ə noʊt, ɔr aɪ fɚˈɡɛt./
dialogue.zh: 寫張紙條給我，不然我會忘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water the plant, the tall green one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔtɚ ðə plænt, ðə tɔl ɡrin wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 澆那株植物，高高綠綠的那株。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How much, a cup or two?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ, ə kʌp ɔr tu?/
dialogue.zh: 澆多少，一杯還是兩杯？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One cup, Sunday and Wednesday.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn kʌp, ˈsʌnˌdeɪ ænd ˈwɛnzˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 一杯，星期天和星期三澆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your plant drinks like me.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr plænt drɪŋks laɪk mi./
dialogue.zh: 你那株植物跟我一樣愛喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My note says it all, look.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ noʊt sɛz ɪt ɔl, lʊk./
dialogue.zh: 我紙條上全都寫了，看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see it, with the cat face.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ɪt, wɪð ðə kæt feɪs./
dialogue.zh: 我看到了，被貓臉壓著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you find the note from me?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju faɪnd ðə noʊt frʌm mi?/
dialogue.zh: 妳找到我留的紙條了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one under the bowl? No.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði wʌn ˈʌndɚ ðə boʊl? noʊ./
dialogue.zh: 碗下面那張嗎？沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It blew away, I think, at six.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt blu əˈweɪ, aɪ θɪŋk, æt sɪks./
dialogue.zh: 它被吹走了，我想是六點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About the parcel box in the hall?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt ðə ˈpɑrsəl bɑks ɪn ðə hɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 是走道上那個包裹箱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That brown box is not ours.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt braʊn bɑks ɪz nɑt aʊrz./
dialogue.zh: 那個棕色箱子不是我們的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I saw it and did not open.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɔ ɪt ænd dɪd nɑt ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 我看到了，也沒打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It belongs to two A, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt bɪˈlɔŋz tə tu eɪ, aɪ θɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 我想那是二A室的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Someone carried it up by mistake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌwʌn ˈkærid ɪt ʌp baɪ mɪsˈteɪk./
dialogue.zh: 有人拿錯樓，帶上來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I labeled the tape for two A.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈleɪbld ðə teɪp fɔr tu eɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我在膠帶上標了二A。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then they will find it at seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðeɪ wɪl faɪnd ɪt æt ˈsɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 那他們七點就會找到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone died, so I used paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn daɪd, soʊ aɪ juzd ˈpeɪpɚ./
dialogue.zh: 我手機沒電了，所以用寫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The note about the late class?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə noʊt əˈbaʊt ðə leɪt klæs?/
dialogue.zh: 那張關於晚課的紙條？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I came home at one.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, aɪ keɪm hoʊm æt wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 對，我一點才回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And your small lamp was still on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd jɔr smɔl læm wʌz stɪl ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 你的小燈還亮著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am sorry I woke you, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈsɑri aɪ woʊk ju ˈtruli./
dialogue.zh: 真的對不起，我把你吵醒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your note said sleep well, so I did.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr noʊt sɛd slip wɛl, soʊ aɪ dɪd./
dialogue.zh: 你紙條上寫著好好睡，所以我就睡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It said: soup in the tin, heat it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛd: sup ɪn ðə tɪn, hit ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 上面寫：湯在罐子裡，熱一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I found it, and it was good.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ faʊnd ɪt, ænd ɪt wʌz ɡʊd./
dialogue.zh: 我找到了，而且很好喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saltier than my noodles, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɔltiɚ ðæn maɪ ˈnudəlz, ðoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 不過比我煮的麵鹹一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I added the potato, remember the trick?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ əˈdædɪd ðə pəˈteɪtoʊ, rɪˈmɛmbɚ ðə trɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 我加了馬鈴薯，記得那招嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The envelope on the counter, what is that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɑnvəˌloʊp ɑn ðə ˈkaʊntɚ, wʌt ɪz ðæt?/
dialogue.zh: 流理台上那個信封，是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our water letter, from the office.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊr ˈwɔtɚ ˈlɛtɚ, frʌm ði ˈɔfɪs./
dialogue.zh: 我們的水費單，管理室送來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open it now, we share the news.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ɪt naʊ, wi ʃɛr ðə nuz./
dialogue.zh: 現在打開，消息兩個人分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty one dollars, this month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti wʌn ˈdɑlɚz, ðɪs mʌnθ./
dialogue.zh: 這個月四十一塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So forty one each, like we said.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈfɔrti wʌn itʃ, laɪk wi sɛd./
dialogue.zh: 所以一人四十一，跟我們約的一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put the note in the jar, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðə noʊt ɪn ðə dʒɑr, tu./
dialogue.zh: 把單據也放進罐子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We are even, this month, check.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɑr ˈivən, ðɪs mʌnθ, tʃɛk./
dialogue.zh: 我們這個月兩清，對一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even, and the chart shows it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən, ænd ðə tʃɑrt ʃoʊz ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 兩清，而且輪值表也寫著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My trip note is on the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ trɪp noʊt ɪz ɑn ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我外出的紙條貼在門上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With the magnet, and your big letters.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð ðə ˈmæɡnət, ænd jɔr bɪɡ ˈlɛtɚz./
dialogue.zh: 用磁鐵壓著，字還寫超大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I write big so you see from bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ raɪt bɪɡ soʊ ju si frʌm bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 我寫大一點，你在床上也看得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It works, I read three last night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɜrks, aɪ rid θri læst naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 有用，我昨晚讀了三張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which three? Show me your memory.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ θri? ʃoʊ mi jɔr ˈmɛmɚi./
dialogue.zh: 哪三張？讓我見識你的記性。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trash Wednesday, soup Friday, key shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /træʃ ˈwɛnzˌdeɪ, sup ˈfraɪˌdeɪ, ki ʃɑp./
dialogue.zh: 星期三倒垃圾、星期五喝湯、鑰匙店。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You remember everything now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju rɪˈmɛmbɚr ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 妳現在什麼都記得。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I signed the note, look, my name.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ saɪnd ðə noʊt, lʊk, maɪ neɪm./
dialogue.zh: 我在紙條上簽名了，看，我的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lock the door when you go out.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɑk ðə dɔr wɛn ju ɡoʊ aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 出門要把鎖鎖上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice, or one turn is enough?
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs, ɔr wʌn tɜrn ɪz ɪˈnʌf?/
dialogue.zh: 兩次嗎，還是轉一下就夠？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two turns, the old lock complains.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu tɜrnz, ðə oʊld lɑk kəmˈpleɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 兩圈，那舊鎖會抱怨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And never leave the key inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ˈnɛvɚ liv ðə ki ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 而且鑰匙別插在門內側。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Once I locked myself in the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌns aɪ lɑkt maɪˈsɛlf ɪn ðə hɔl./
dialogue.zh: 有一次我把自己鎖在門外。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In pajamas, at six, in rain?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn pəˈdʒæməz, æt sɪks, ɪn reɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 穿睡衣，六點，還下雨？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and your mother had the spare.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ænd jɔr ˈmʌðɚ hæd ðə spɛr./
dialogue.zh: 對，幸好你媽媽有備用鑰匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not tell her that story.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt tɛl hɜr ðæt ˈstɔri./
dialogue.zh: 別把那件事告訴她。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday I come back at four.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfraɪˌdeɪ aɪ kʌm bæk æt fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 星期五我四點回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The key box, code, you know it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ki bɑks, kod, ju noʊ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 鑰匙盒、密碼，你知道的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I changed it, look at the note.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ tʃeɪnd ɪt, lʊk æt ðə noʊt./
dialogue.zh: 我換過了，看那張紙條。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four digits, no birthday, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈdɪdʒɪts, noʊ ˈbɜrθˌdeɪ, pliz./
dialogue.zh: 四位數，拜託別用生日。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six this time, harder to guess.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ðɪs taɪm, ˈhɑrdɚ tə ɡɛs./
dialogue.zh: 這次六碼，更難猜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write it on paper, not the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ɪt ɑn ˈpeɪpɚ, nɑt ðə bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 寫在紙上，別寫在盒子外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sandwich note, was that yours?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsændwɪtʃ noʊt, wʌz ðæt jɔrz?/
dialogue.zh: 那張關於三明治的紙條，是妳留的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yours, with the half and the label.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔrz, wɪð ðə hæf ænd ðə ˈleɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 你留的嘛，半個還有標籤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I ate it, I was so hungry.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ eɪt ɪt, aɪ wʌz soʊ ˈhʌŋɡri./
dialogue.zh: 我吃掉了，那時候好餓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave a note, then I feel fair.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ə noʊt, ðɛn aɪ fil fɛr./
dialogue.zh: 那留張紙條，我才覺得公平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next note says: thank you, Nora.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst noʊt sɛz: θæŋk ju, ˈnɔrə./
dialogue.zh: 下一張就寫：謝謝你，諾拉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the small gift from the sea?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə smɔl ɡɪft frʌm ðə si?/
dialogue.zh: 還有那從海邊帶回來的小禮物？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dried fish, for your soup pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪd fɪʃ, fɔr jɔr sup pɑt./
dialogue.zh: 乾魚，煮湯用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sunday, then, with the tall shelf clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌnˌdeɪ, ðɛn, wɪð ðə tɔl ʃɛlf klɪr./
dialogue.zh: 那就星期天，把高架子清空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The chart is full of notes now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tʃɑrt ɪz fʊl ʌv noʊts naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 那張表現在貼滿紙條。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the door has two cards, one light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə dɔr hæz tu kɑrdz, wʌn laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 門上有兩張卡，還有一盞燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First month done, and we are here.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɝst mʌnθ dʌn, ænd wi ɑr hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 第一個月結束了，我們還在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Best roommate score, so far, ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛst ˈrumˌmeɪt skɔr, soʊ fɑr, tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 室友評分，目前滿分十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten thirty, the lamp dies tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈθɝdi, ðə læm daɪz təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 十點半，今晚小燈也關。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My alarm is the watch, remember.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ əˈlɑrm ɪz ðə wɑtʃ, rɪˈmɛmbɚ./
dialogue.zh: 我的鬧鐘是手錶，記得喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, note, key, and chart.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt, noʊt, ki, ænd tʃɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 晚安，紙條、鑰匙、輪值表。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, spare pillow, window side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt, spɛr ˈpɪloʊ, ˈwɪndoʊ saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 晚安，備用枕頭、窗邊那一邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you at the kettle, eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju æt ðə ˈkɛtl, eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 八點壺邊見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet, and bring the noodle pack.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət, ænd brɪŋ ðə ˈnudəl pæk./
dialogue.zh: 小聲點，還要把麵帶來。
